tei:div.tei:p: — — 〉 —ri — zheshu / —shu pa ri jetreji — —ci༄
rig rtsom skad cha'i rigs dang rtsom 'jug gi rnam gzhag rin chen sil ma/gzungs 'bum thar gyis brtsams/kan su'u mi rigs dpe skrun khang /

dkar chagadakar chagarig rtsom skad cha'i rigs kyi rnam gzhag rin chen rjo 'bigs bcad dang po/ sngon 'gro'i yan lag (3)don tshan dang po/ rig rtsom skad cha zhes pa'i rig rtsom gyi sgyur tshul bshad pa/ (3)don tshan gnyis pa/ rig rtsom ska da cha'i go don ba sha da pa / (6)don tshan gsum pa/ rig rtsom skad cha'i rtsa ba'i khyad chos bshad pa/ (9)sa bcad gnyis pa/ gzhung don dngos gzhi/ (16)don tshan dang po/ ༷ga rtsom skad cha'i rigs dbye tshul bshad don tshan gnyis paspu/ ri/ ga rtsom skad cha'i ri ga sa rna ma sa so (16)sor bshad pa/ (27)mjug bsdu ba'i gtam/ (88)rtsom 'jug gi bshad khrid gnad rings gzur gnas 'jug ngogs/sa bcad dang po/ rtsom 'jug gi go rim dang rtsa ba'i nus pa/1(93)

rig rtsom skad cha'i rigs kyi rnam gzhag rin chen rno 'bigs bcad gnyis pa/ 'tshol sdud kyi dus rim/ (101)sa bcad gsum pa/ bsam bkod kyi dus rim/ (113)sa bcad bzhi pa/ mtshon brjod kyi dus rim/ (122)sa bcad lnga pa/ rig rtsom 'bri tshul/ (142)sa bcad drug pa/ gzhung rtsom 'bri tshul/ (150)mjug byang / (161)
da cha'i riposden chen rno

sa bcad dang po/ sngon 'gro'i yan lags bcad dang po/ sngon 'gro'i yan lagadon tshan dang po/ rig rtsom skad cha zhes pa'i rig rtsom gyi bsgyur tshul bshad pa/rig rtsom zhes pa'i tha snyad kyi go sden gang yin nam zhe na/ tha snyad 'di yong khungs kyi cha nas bshad na/ rig rtsom zhes pa'i tha snyad ni la ting skad kyi 11 ༷7lngaspyo5ཿ ’ zhes pa las 'ongs shing don ni yi ges bris pa'i dngos po ste/ bod skad nang gi yig rtsom dang don gcig go /spyi tshogs kyi 'tsho ba 'phel rgyas su song ba dang bstun nas rig rtsom zhes pa'i tha snyad kyi go don la'ang 'gyur ba byung ste/ dang thog gi yi ges bris pa'i dngos po zhes pa'i don dang tha dad du song /deng skabs 'dzam gling steng du rig rtsom gyi go don thad bzhed pa mi mthun pa du ma snang yang grags che ba ni skad cha bkol nas nyams btod pa'i sgyu rtsal gyi brtsams chos zhes pa dang skad dang yi ger brten pa dang rnam rtog gi nus pas grogs byas te mi rnams kyis nyams su myangs pa'i bsam pa dang / brtse dung mtshon pa'i sgyu rwal

rig rtsom skad cha'i rigs kyi rnam gzhag rin chen rno 'bigagyi brtsams chos zhes pa lta bu'o/ /go don de dag gzhir bzung nas bshad na/ da lta rang re'i tshags par dang dus deb sogs kyi steng du rtsom rig ces bsgyur ba la skyon byung yod de/ spyir bod skad kyi tha snyad 'dogs tshul la gso rig dang rtsis rig sogs kyi ming gi cha shas rig ces pa ni gzhung ngam gzhung lugs la go dgos/ de ltar min par shes pa dang don gcig pa'i rig pa la go dgos zer na rang mtshang bstan pa las ci yang mi snang / de'i gnad kyis skad cha'i sgyu rtsal gyi ming la rtsom rig ces bsgyur na rtsom gzhung la go 'gro ba red/ 'o na/ gang ltar bsgyur na 'grig gam zhe na/ gong bkod ltar rig rtsom zhes bsgyur na legs par 'dod de/ bod rang gi tha snyad 'dogs tshul dang mthun zhing go log mi 'byung ba dang / rig pa'i 'phrul las byung ba'i rtsom zhes sgra bshad byas na'ang go ba lhag pa zhig ster rgyu yod snyam/gal te mi la las skad cha'i sgyu rtsal gyi ming la rtsom rig ces bsgyur ba la skyon yod kyang da ni yongs su grags pas bcos thabs bral zhe na/ yongs su grags pa la rgyu mtshan yang dag med cing / gal te yongs su grags pa'i dbang du btang na'ang bcos thabs med pa ga la yin/ tshang mas shes gsal ltar/ da char bod rigs spyi'i mi grangs las mang shos ni yig rmongs pa dang / nyung shos ni yi ge shes ma/na dang yon tan pa red/ yi ge shes mkhan las kyang mi nyung tsam

sa bcad dang po/ sngon 'gro'i yan lagagyis ma gtogs rig rtsom la go ba yang dag pa cig len mi shes par 'dug pas/ rtsom rig ces tha snyad yongs su grags zhe na rigs pa don mthun nam mkha'i pad+mo'i mched zlar ma song ngam/ gal te rtsom rig ces yongs su grags kyang bcos thabs med pa ga la yin te/bod skad la mtshon na chos rgyal lo paṇa rim byon rnams kyis bkas bcad thengs gsum byas pa lta bu dang / rgya nag gi skad la mtshon na/sngon chad phyi gling sogs nas sman dang rdzas 'gyur rig pa/ dngos lugs rig pa sogs kyi tha snyad mang po 'gyur yod pa las/ da char rgya nag rang gi tha snyad 'dogs tshul dang mi mthun pa rnams mkhas pa dag gis skad kyi dwangs ma'i phyogs la dmigs te bcos dang bcos mus su yod pa ltar ro/ /yang gal te mi la las sgra ni brjod 'dod rjes 'brangs phyir zhes gsungs yod pas rtsom rig ces btsan sbyor byas te btags chog ce na/ bdag gi rmongs blor shar tshod ltar na/ lung de'i don ni sgra ni brjod par 'dod pa'i kun slong skyes pa'i rjes su 'brangs nas skyes pa'am byung ba yin zhes pa las/ ming brda yod tshad 'jig rten tha snyad 'dogs tshul gyi gnas lugs dang bstun mi dgos par gang dran dran du btags chog ces pa'i don ni min las che snyam/ gal te de ltar yin na bod skad la bkas bcad thengs gsum byas pa dang dag yig sogs brtsams pa la dgos pa ci yang med par 'gyur ro/ /5

rig rtsom skad cha'i rigs kyi rnam gzhag rin chen rno 'thagadon tshan gnyis pa/ rig rtsom skad cha'i go don bshad pa/ci zhig la rig rtsom skad cha zer zhe na/ gnad don de'i thad du rgyal khab phyi nang gi mkhas pa rnams kyi 'dod tshul gcig mthun min yang phyogs bsdus byas na gsham gsal ltar/1 su'u len gyi yi sa pi ta h+phus rang gi sgyu rtsal rtsom rig gi gleng gzhir rig rtsom skad cha ni dmangs yongs kyi skad cha'i nang du yod pa'i dmigs bsal tshad ldan gyi skad cha zhig yin par bstan 'dug2 h+pha ran si pa h+phang te li yi sa'i rig rtsom skad cha'i 'dod tshul ni/ dpe thog gi skad cha dang rig rtsom skad cha gcig tu mi bsres par rig rtsom mkhas dbang gis bkol spyod byed pa'i skad cha khyad par ba zhig yin pa de red/3 rgya nag pa dbyi chon gyis gtso sgrig byas pa'i rig rtsom gyi rtsa ba'i gzhung lugs zhes pa'i nang du rig rtsom skad cha la go don khyab che chung gnyis yod de/ go don khyab che ba'i rig rtsom skad cha ni mi rigs thun mong gi skad cha'i rmang gzhi'i steng du gsar bzo byas pa'i daṭ+wāṃ deb thog gi skad cha la bstan zhing / de'i nang du rig rtsom

sa bcad dang po/ sngon 'gro'i yan lagabartsams chos kyi skad cha 'dus pa ma zad/ tshan rig gsung rtsom dang chab srid ched rtsom/ tshags par dang dus deb steng du bkol spyod byas pa'i dpe deb thog gi skad cha mtha' dag dang gsar bzo byas pa'i ngag thog gi skad cha'ang 'dus so/ /brda sprod rig pa'i nang du bkol ba'i rig rtsom skad cha zhes pa'i don ni/ spyir btang du go don khyab che ba'i rig rtsom skad cha la bstan pa yin/ go don khyab chung ba'i rig rtsom skad ni snyan rtsom dang lhug rtsom/ sgrung rtsom dang zlos gar sogs kyi rig rtsom brtsams chos kyi skad cha dang mi dmangs kyi ngag thog gi gsar rtsom nang du las snon brgyud pa'i rig rtsom skad cha la ched dmigs kyis bstan pa red/ rig rtsom gzhung lugs nang du bshad pa'i rig rtsom skad cha zhes pa ni/ rgyun du go don khyab chung ba'i rig rtsom skad cha la bstan pa yin zhes bshad do/ /gong bkod mkhas pa rnams kyis phyogs mi 'dra ba'i sgo nas rig rtsom skad cha la 'grel byas pa der rang blos dpag tshod kyis bod kyi rig rtsom skad cha dang bsdur nas cung dpyad na/1 yi sa pi ta khu h+phu'i 'dod tshul de rang re'i bod kyi rig rtsom skad char sbyar na don la mi gnas pa'i cha mchis te/ bod kyi rig rtsom nang du yul skad kyis brtsams pa yod de/ dper na mi la ras pa'i rnam mgur lta bur mtshon na yul skad mang ba dang / zlos gar dang sgrung rtsom nang du mi sna'i skad cha las yul skad mang ba lta7 bu

rig rtsom skad cha'i rigs kyi rnam gzhag rin chen rno 'bigared/ de bas/ dmangs yongs kyi skad cha'i nang du yod pa'i dmigs bsal tshad ldan gyi skad cha ni min no/ /2 h+phang te li si'i 'dod tshul yang rang re'i bod kyi rig rtsom skad cha dang sbyar na 'phal ga mi 'phrod de/ ge sar sgrung lta bur mtshon na rig rtsom mkhas pas brtsams pa min yang de'i skad cha ni mang tshogs kyi ngag thog las gsar bzo byas pa'i rig rtsom skad cha yag po yin pas/ rig rtsom skad cha min par su zhig gis bsgrub thub/3 dbyi chon gyis gtso sgrig byas pa'i rig rtsom rtsa ba'i gzhung lugs zhes pa'i nang du bstan pa'i rig rtsom skad cha'i go don khyab che chung gnyis yod de/ go don khyab che ba ni brda sprod rig pa'i nang du bstan pa'i rig rtsom skad cha'i go don yin pas/ bod kyi rig rtsom skad cha la sbyor mi rigs so/ go don khyab chung ba ni phal cher don la gnas te rig rtsom skad cha la snyan rtsom dang sgrung rtsom dang zlos gar sogs kyi rig rtsom brtsams chos kyi skad cha dang mi dmangs kyi ngag thog gi gsar rtsom nang du las snon brgyud pa'i rig rtsom skad cha zhes rnam pa gnyis su phye ba lta bu red/ yin na'ang rig rtsom skad cha la mtshan nyid cha tshang ba zhig bzhag med pas lhad med yang dag go zhes brjod dka' ba'o/ /'o na/ khyod kyi 'dod tshul gang yin nam zhe na/rig rtsom skad cha zhes pa'i skabs 'di'i skad cha ni rig rtsom gyi 8

sa bcad dang po/ sngon 'gro'i yan lagayin pa las gzhan gyi ma yin par rnam par bcad pa dang / rig rtsom ni khyad gzhi dang skad cha ni khyad chos yin/ rig rtsom gyi go don gong du smras pa ltar dang / skad cha'i go don ni brda sprod rig pa las yi ge du ma 'dus pa las ming dang / ming du ma 'dus pa las tshig dang tshig du ma 'dus pa las brjod pa grub ces pa'i brjod pa dang /mtshan nyid rig pa las rjod byed ces pa dang / gzhan yang ngag sbyor zhes pa rnams don gcig ming gi rnam grangs so/ /mdor na/ rig rtsom skad cha ni rig rtsom gyi rjod byed kyi ngag ji snyed la go dgos/ der gnas stangs kyi cha nas phye na/ yig thog rig rtsom skad cha dang ngag thog rig rtsom skad cha gnyis yod do/ /don tshan gsum pa/ rig rtsom skad cha'i rtsa ba'i khyad chos bshad pa/rig rtsom skad cha la spyir btang du rtsom rigs skad cha'i gnad la 'khel ba dang / bsdus shing gsal ba/ gson nyams ldan pa bcas kyi khyad chos yod pa ma gtogs da dung rang gi khyad chos yod de/ dper na/ rig rtsom skad cha dang tshan rig skad cha gnyis bsdur nas bshad na/ tshan rig skad chas spyi mtshan gyi rnam gzhag(chos nyid)rags bsdus su byed cing / de'i rtsa ba'i khyad chos ni gnad la 9

rig rtsom skad cha'i rigs kyi rnam gnag rin chen rno 'thaga'akhel zhing tshags dam pa'o/ /rig rtsom skad chas sgyu rtsal gyi nyams(snang brnyan)btod par byed pa ste/ bye brag tshor ba can dang rags bsdus/ mdzes sdug gi byed las yod pa'i mi tshe'i dpe ris su 'be+ebs pa lta bu'o/ /de bas/ rig rtsom skad cha'i rtsa ba'i khyad chos 'ga' yod pa spro bar bya ste/1 don gyi nyams ldan pa/rig rtsom gyis sgyu rtsal gyi nyams btod pa'i sgo nas spyi tshogs kyi 'tsho ba mtshon par byed pa yin pas/ klog mkhan la nyams su myang bar bya ba ni rig rtsom gyi bye brag tshor can dang gson nyams ldan pa'i mi tshe yin pa las/ spyi mtshan gyi don spyi dang bro med skam po'i spyi 'gros min/ rig rtsom gyi khyad chos des rig rtsom skad cha la don gyi nyams nges par du ldan dgos pa thag gcod byas pa red/ don gyi nyams ldan pa'i skad cha zhes pa ni/ 'tsho ba'i snang tshul sna tshogs bye brag gis bkod 'bri byas pa brgyud de 'tsho ba'i ngo bo mtshon pa la zer/de la dpe 'jog byas na/ mi la ras pa'i rnam thar〉las/ a mas nga yin par ha las te/ skam pa g.yas su bor/ yos dkrugs g.yon du bor/ yos brngos 'phro tshig tu bcug lag pa g.yas su yog pa zhig khyer/ g.yon du thal ba spar gang khyer/ skas 10

sa bcad dang po/ sngon 'gro'i yan lagaring ba las babs thung ba la mchongs nas phyir byung ste/ thal ba de gdong la btab/ yog pa de mgo la lan 'ga' brgyab nas yab mi la shes rab rgyal mtshan khyed la bu 'di 'dra zhig skyes so/ /khyed rabs chad gda' ba nged ma smad kyi las bskos la gzigs dang zhes a ma yug gcig brgyal nas 'gyel zhes pa lta bu myang tsha dkar rgyan khros pa'i nyams bye brag gis bkod 'bri byas pa red/yang na/ gzhon nu drug gi rtogs brjod〉las/ lus mdangs gos dkar skra yis phrogs te gyon/ /skra yi nags tshal lus la byugs pa bzhin/ /rtsa yi zhags pas rgad po'i yan lag bcings/ /gnyer ma'i dra bas rtsa yang bcings pa bzhin/ /yul gyi dngos po mi sdug gyur ba dang / /ro 'dzin zas kyi rtsom pa bral rig nas/ /'dren byed nang du bros te sgrib bzhin lta/ /so rnams phyi ru byung ste 'bros pa 'dra/ / ’zhes pa lta bu rgad po'i rgas nyams bye brag gis snang tshul sna tshogs brgyud de bkod 'bri byas pa red/2 'byor cing bsdus pa/tshig 'byor ba zhes pa ni brjod bya'i dngos po gang zhig gi ngo bo 11

rig rtsom skad cha'i rigs kyi rnam gzhag rin chen rno 'thagadang rnam 'gyur dang khyad chos rjod byed tshig gis yang dag par mtshon nus pa la zer zhing / bsdus pa zhes pa ni tshig nyung ba'i sgo nas phun sum tshogs pa'i 'tsho ba dang / bsam pa ris 'bebs dang phyogs bsdus byas pa la bya'o/ /dper na/ṭ+wāṃsnang sa 'od 'bum〉las/ kha rog bsdad na bu mo glen ma zer/ /gtam lan byas na bu mo'i pher sha zer/ /phyi la phyin na mgo yang 'chal mo zer /nang du bsdad na lha khang logs ris zer ’zhes pa ltar tshig nyung zhing don 'dus pa dang tshig des brjod don yang dag par mtshon pa red/yang na/ shan gdan stag seng kha sprod〉las/ ‘stag rong a khu khro thur zer ba blo rgod che la dpa' snying med pa/ 'jigs mdog che zhing bya lag mang ba/ ḍa ru 'dra ba'i ngo gnyis ma/ dril bu 'dra ba'i lce gnyis ma/ mgo bde dran 'phrul la byang chub pa zhig yod/ ’ces pa lta bu tshig 'byor zhing nyung ba red/3 yid 'gyur gyis phyug pa/rig rtsom skad cha la yid 'gyur gyis phyug pa'i khyad chos de rig rtsom gsar rtsom gyi khyad chos kyis thag gcod byas pa ste/ yid 'gyur 12

sa bcad dang po/ sdon 'gro'i yan lagani snyan ngag mkhan dang rig rtsom mkhas dbang gis gsar rtsom byed dus med du mi rung ba'i rgyu rkyen zhig red/ de'i gnad kyis snyan ngag mkhan dang rig rtsom mkhas dbang gis gsar rtsom byed pa'i go rim nang du rgyun par yid 'gyur gyis khengs yod pas/ de rnams kyi brtsams chos la yid 'gyur gyis gtams pa dang / khong tsho'i phyag gi yo byad de rig rtsom skad chas rtsom mkhan gyi yid 'gyur mtshon phyir yid 'gyur gyi khu bas bran par byas med mi srid la/ skabs rer mthug pa dang skabs rer srab pa'i yid 'gyur gyi tshon mdangs mngon par byed do/ /dper na/ rgyal dbang lnga ba'ispyorje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi bstod pa tam bu ra'i rgyud mangs〉las/‘‘mtha' bral rlabs chen mdzad pa mchog gi nor/ /phyur bur spungs pa gcig tu shong ba'i snod/ /sprul la 'jig rten mes po ngal gyur na/ /srid gsum 'di yang da rung chung ngur 'khums/ /’ zhes pa lta bu rje btsun 'jam dbyangs kyi rlabs chen mdzad par yid 'gyur shugs drag skyes te mtshon pa red/yang na/ gzhon nu zla med kyi gtam rgyud〉las/ phade nas dpa' bo srid pa gzhon nu des chas gos phun sum tshogs pas legs par bklubs nas 'khor nyung ngus bskor te rgyal bu gzhon nu zla med 13

rig rtsom skad cha'i rigs kyi rnam gnag rin chen rno 'bagaltar badzus nas rim gyis 'ongs te skyed tshal du 'byor ba na/ ljon shing dra ba stug por 'khrigs pa'i phag nas zur gyis bltas pas rgyu skar gyi dbus na zla ba'i dkyil 'khor ltar ram/ bya bran gyi dbus na ngang ba'i bu mo mngon par rgyu ba bzhin bran mo gzhon nu du ma'i dbus na mdzes chos kyi khyad par gzhan gyis bsgrun par mi bzod pa'i dpal yon dang ldan pa/ dkar skum mtho la mkhrang ba'i 'dod pa'i myos bum rnam par rgyas pa/ rab dkar gzhon sha legs par chags pa'i lang tsho'i me tog gzi byin 'bar ba/ smad cha chu gos sngon po yid du 'ong ba bklubs pa las brla'i dbyibs gsal bar 'char ba 'jig rten gyi mdzes sdug ma lus pa'i snying bo yid 'ong ma de nyid khrus la zhugs pa mthong ngo /’mizhes pa lta bu yid 'gyur gyis bran par byas pa'i tshig red/4 rol dbyangs kyi nyams phun sum tshogs pa/yi ge 'jam rgyob kyi sdeb sbyor dang tsheg bar gyi cha ya/ tshig sdud dang zung ldan dang dbyangs nges pa sogs kyi sgo nas sgra'i nyams phun sum tshogs pas mnyan na rna bar 'jebs pa dang bklags na rang shugs kyis ngag las thon pa la rol dbyangs kyi nyams zer zhing /rig rtsom skad cha la rol dbyangs kyi nyams kyis phyug go /14dper na/ rje tsong kha pa'i bstod pa chu 'dzin ma〉las/ snyerol

sa bcad dang po/ sngon 'gro'i yan lagartsed gar gyi nyams ldan ri dwags mig /mig gis lta bas mi ngoms yid 'phrog ma/ /ma ltar brtse ba khyod kyis bdag gi ngag /ngag dbang lha mo nyid dang mtshungs par mdzod/ / ces pa lta bu mtha' thog sbyar trīsdo/ zung ldan gyi sgo nas rol dbyangs kyi nyams phun sum tshogs pa yang na/ gzhon nu drug gi rtog brjod〉las/ ‘‘rim gyis skyed mos tshal yid du 'ong ba/ rtswa'i myu gu gsar du 'khrungs pas ni sa gzhi bkab pa bzhin du 'dug /me tog rnam par bkra ba mang po ni 'bar/ lo 'dab rab tu rgyas pa'i ljon shing rnams kyis ni gang /bung ba mang po'i glu snyan pa ni byis pas bsgyur pa'i gling bu dang 'gran pa bzhin du byed pa rnams su rab tu rgyu shing song song ba las/shing mya ngan med pa'i bsti gnas shin tu bsil zhing nyams dga' ba zhig na/ lha'i bu mo la 'gran pa lta bu'i bud med lang tsho rab tu rgyas shing lta na sdug pa me long gsar ba smra shes pa 'dra ba zhig rgyud mangs shin tu snyan pa sgreng zhing / kun tu dga' ba'i glu len la 'bangs mo dang bcas pa rtse zhing 'dus pa mthong ngo /’ zhes pa lta bu tshig sdud ༵r+sha py-irdokā snashāXr+sha so/ gas kyi sgo nas sgra'i rol nyams phun sum 15

rig rtsom skad cha'i rigs kyi rnam gzhag rin chen rno 'thags bcad gnyis pa/ gzhung don dngos gzhi/don tshan dang po/ rig rtsom skad cha'i rigs dbye tshul bshad pa/dang po/ rig rtsom skad cha'i rigs dbye ba'i dgos pa/rig rtsom skad cha ni rig rtsom gyi rgyu rkyen ang dang po dang / de'i rnam gzhag ni rig rtsom gzhung lugs la med du mi rung ba'i grub cha gal chen zhig yin pas/ de la rigs kyi rnam gzhag byas na dgos pa chen po du ma snang zhing rags bsdus byas na gsham gsal ltar te/yod dṛ/ rig rtsom gzhung lugs 'dzugs jin gyi don snying deng skabs bod kyi rig rtsom gzhung lugs med pa nas yod pa dang cha shas nas cha tshang bar 'dzugs skrun byed sgang yin stabs/rig rtsom gyi grub cha gzhan pa'i ched rtsom ni char rjes kyi sha mo brdol 16

sa bcad gnyis pa/ gzhung don dngos gzhi/ba bzhin snang yang / rig rtsom skad cha la rnam gzhag byas pa ni phal cher nyin mo'i rgyu skar gyi tshul du song bas/ rig rtsom gzhung lugs cha mi tshang ba red/ ‘mi rigs kyi skad cha ni mi rigs kyi shes rig gi rnam pa’midang / mi rigs kyi rig rtsom gyi rgyu rkyen ang dang po yin pas/rig rtsom skad cha la rnam gzhag bya rgyu ni rig rtsom gzhung lugs 'dzugs skrun gyi bya ba gal chen zhig red/ bod kyi rig rtsom skad cha la rnam gzhag byed pa'i bya ba'ang de las ma 'das/ de'i gnad kyis bod kyi rig rtsom skad cha la rigs kyi rnam gzhag byas na rig rtsom gzhung lugs 'dzugs skrun gyi don snying gal che ba ldan pa red/2 bod mi rigs kyi sbyi skad bzo bar phan thogs che ba/spyi tshogs kyi 'tsho ba 'phel rgyas su song ba dang bstun te mi rigs kyi skad cha'ang 'phel rgyas su 'gro bzhin snang / da skabs bod rigs la mtshon na/ thag gcod byed rgyu'i gnad don mang po zhig 'dug kyang kha skad dang yig skad kyi bar thag je nyer gtong ba dang yul skad chen po gsum gcig gyur bya ba de gnyis ni kha tsha dgos gtugs kyi gnad don red/yig skad dang kha skad kyi gnad ka'i steng nas bshad na/ kha skad nang du yod pa'i tha snyad skor zhig yig skad nang du med la/yig skad nang du yod pa'i tha snyad skor zhig kha skad nang du mi snang /17

rig rtsom skad cha'i rigs kyi rnam gzhag rin chen rno 'jigasnga ma dper na rgya nag gi skad dupharki 47zer ba de yig skad du mis bzos pags pa zhes pa la kha skad du bzos pags zhes su grags pa lta bu dang / phyi ma ni dper na yig skad nang du rgya nag skad kyipha skya7zhes pa de glog brnyan zhes 'gyur legs kyang kha skad du rgya skad sgra bsgyur byas te ten yin zhes brjod pa lta bu'o/ /yul skad kyi steng nas bshad na/ am skad dang dbus gtsang skad/ khams skad gsum phan tshun 'phrad tshe brda 'phrod dka' ba red/ de la am skad dang dbus skad steng nas rgod bro ba'i dpe zhig drangs na/ a mdo'i skad du pa pha ba ma zhes pa'i ba la 7 zhes 'don pa dang / dbus skad du 2 dz+ra zhes 'do na pa'i sgra'i khyad par gyis dbus gtsang bas rang la bod pa 2 1 kyi8: mizhes 'bod cing rang las gzhan bod pa(2 7 kyi8 )min par 'dod de/ dbus gtsang ngam bod rang skyong ljongs la slebs par dga' bsu zhu zer dgos pa la bod la slebs par dga' bsu zhu zhes bris 'dug pa lha sa grong khyer nas bdag gis mthong / a mdo'i dmangs khrod du'ang dbus gtsang ba la bod pa(2 ཿ khyi8’)zhes 'bod cing rang bod pa(2 dz+rakyi 1)minazhing bod pa(spoXspyokyi )yin par 'dod do//gong smos gnad don de dag gi dbang gis rig rtsom skad cha spyi dang khyad par du rig rtsom skad cha'i rigs la zhib 'jug byas na bod mi rigs kyi kha skad dang yig skad thag je nyer gtong thub pa 18

sa bcad gnyis pa/ gzhung don dngos gzhi/dang yul skad rnams gcig gyur byas te spyi skad bzo bar phan thogs che ba red/3 klog 'don dang rtsom 'bri la slob ston byed zub pa/mi'i shes yon sna tshogs spyi tshogs 'tsho ba'i lag len nas spyi sdom byas te thob pa las gzhan/ gtso cher klog 'don la brten dgos/ rig rtsom brtsams chos mtha' yas pa yod pa las/ skad cha dang tha snyad phun sum tshogs pa red/ gal te de rnams rnam par ma phye na mi rnams kyis 'tshol ba dang slob sbyong byed dka' 'o/ /mi gang zhig la rig rtsom skad cha'i rigs kyi rnam gzhag gi shes yon dang ldan tshe/ des rig rtsom gyi nang don dang sgyu rtsal gyi khyad chos la dbye zhib dang go ba len par rogs ram byed thub bo/ /rig rtsom skad cha ni rigs rtsom gyi rgyu rkyen gal chen zhig yin zhing / de la rigs kyi rnam gzhag byas na phan pa che ste/ rtsom mkhan gyi steng nas bshad na/ rtsom 'bri skabs rig rtsom nang don ltar skad cha gdam gses byas te tshig sbyor spel dgos la/ klog mkhan gyi steng nas bshad na/ rtsom mkhan gyis rig rtsom gyi nang don mtshon pa'i skad cha de don la 'byor min dang sgyu rtsal gi nyams yod med la tshor snang nges can zhig yod do/ /rtsom mkhan la rig rtsom skad cha'i rigs kyi shes yon ldan tshe/ rig rtsom gyi nang don dang rnam pa la 'os spyang

rig rtsom skad cha'i rigs kyi rnam gnag rin chen rno 'thaga'atsham pa'i tshig sbyor spel thub bo/ /de'i gnad kyis rig rtsom skad cha'i rigs la rnam gzhag byed pa de'ang rtsom 'bri ba'i lag len gyi dgos mkho'ang yin no/ /4 slob khrid dang zhib 'jug la phan pa/dge rgan gyis rig rtsom skad cha'i rigs kyi rnam gzhag la cha rgyus lon pa na/ rig rtsom skad cha'i rigs so so'i ngo bo dang khyad chos/ byed las dang rtsom 'bri ba'i blang bya shes te/ rig rtsom skad cha'i rigs rnams la 'khrid thabs dang bkod sgrig 'os 'tsham byas te slob khrid pa phan 'bras 'byung du 'jug pa dang / slob ma'i slob sbyong dang rtsom 'bri ba la'ang slob ston byed thub pa red/ dper na/ snyan ngag la 'jug tshul tshig rgyan rig pa'i sgo 'byed〉las/phartag par gzhan phan las la 'bad pa dag /gang brtsams bya ba mtha' dag 'bras bzang ldan/ /lhag bsam dkar bas gzhan phan bya bar dga'/ /nya rgyas zla ba gsal dang yang dag mnyam/ / zhes pa lta bu dge rgan gyis slob khrid byed dus gug gu dang zhabs kyu dang 'breng bu dang na ro gang rung tshig rkang bzhi ga la med pa la dbyangs a nges pa zhes zer te rim bzhin khrid na dge rgan gyis 'chad bde la slob mas nges sla bar ma zad/ slob mas rtsom 'bri 20

sa bcad gnyis pa/ gzhung don dngos gzhi/ba la'ang slob ston byed thub pa red/rig rtsom zhib 'jug byed mkhan zhig la rig rtsom skad cha'i rigs kyi shes yon ldan tshe/ skad cha'i sgo nas ngag sbyor sgyu rtsal la zhib 'jug yag po byas te rig rtsom skad cha'i khyad chos mngon par mtshon thub bo/ /dper na/ sprin bzhon rtogs brjod〉las/ snyan pa dbyar skyes sngon mo'i skad la za/’ zhes pa'i tshigs bcad der tsheg khyim cha bzhi'i mthar ya gcig yod pa yin zhing / dbyar skyes ni 'brug gi mngon brjod dang skad la za ni skad la 'gran pa'i don te las tshig gi bkol spyod ngo mtshar ba red ces zhib 'jug byas na stabs bde zhing tshig sbyor gyi khyad chos mtshon thub pa lta bu'o/ /gnyis ba/ rig rtsom skad cha'i rigs dbye tshul dngos bshadapa/1 bod kyi rig rtsom skad cha la skad rigs nang khul du khyad par phye na yul skad dang phal skad dang yig skad gsum yod de/ rim par dper brjod na/ spyogatsug g.yu〉las/ ‘nyin zhig a cag gsal sgron lags kyis dpal ldan 'gram du bskongs nas lag par ras sgril zhig sprad de dpal ldan/ slo ma 'di sku ngo mda' dpon la phul shog 'bul dus sngon la phyag 'bul 21

rig rtsom skad cha'i rigs kyi rnam gzhag rin chen rno 'thagagacig zhus nas lag pa gnyis kyis slo ma 'di gsol lcog la bzhag rjes/ 'di a cag gsal sgron lags kyis phul shog gsung gi 'dugazhal tog spro bo mi 'dug kyang sems kyi khyad par yin gsung gi 'dug zer zhus ang zhes bshad de btang / ’zhes pa lta bu dbus gtsang gi yul skad dang / dge 'dun chos 'phel gyis bla brang la bskur ba'i ka rtsom las/ ga yang gnas chung 'phrin las rgyal po yis/ /nga rgyal che bas sdod du ma bcug zer/ /mi’zhes pa lta bu a mdo'i yul skad dang / gzhan yang‘ 'ba' gzhas7lta bu khams pa'i yul skad red/ phal skad ni zhang btsun bstan pa rgya mtshos/ phalus dben pa'i gnas su bsnad na yang / /sems grong yul gyi nor rdzas la chags na/ /gnas lung stong 'grim pa'i spyang ki bzhin/ /tshe don med du gtong ba'i phung 'dre yin/ /’mizhes pa dang mi la ras pa'i rnam mgur〉las/ /dzing ni dar seng dkar mo'i bu/ /a ma'i mngal nas rtsal gsum rdzogs/ /phrug gu'i lo la tshang du nyal/ /thong ba'i lo la tshang sgo bsrung / /dar ma'i lo la gangs stod 'grims/ /nga gangs bu yug 'tshubs rung ya mi nga / /brag g.yang sa che rung bag mi tsha/ /’ zhes pa lta bu go sla zhing stabs bde ba red/yig skad ni/ bsngags 'os bsngags pa〉las/dzinyin byed li khri'i 'od kyis rab phye skyon med ge sar rdul 22 ldan yang //

sa bcad gnyis pa/ gzhung don dngos gzhi/sbrang rtsi don gnyer bung ba ma zhugs srod rlung 'jam pos zil mnan pa'i/ /pad+ma r+shakās/ /kyi don byed mi nus rang bzhin kho nas zum pa'i mngond trīje sdi kār+sha pa/ḍi bung ba'i phreng ba nya ngar mgrin pa'i pa'o/ce/sa pa lta bu tshig nyung zhing don 'dus la tshig sbyor tshags dam 2 rig rtsom skad cha de tshig sbyor gyi rnam pa'i steng nas dbye na tshigs bcad dang tshig lhug spel ma gsum yod de/ rim par dper brjod na/ 'ju mi pham gyis/phamathon mthing nor bu'i 'od chags kun gsal dbyings/ /gser zhun khu bas legs par byugs pa bzhin/ /'char ka'i 'od bzang snang bas mdun bsus te/ /srid pa'i sgron me shar gyi ri la 'dzeg /’’ces pa lta bu tshigs bcad dang / rgyal dbang lnga ba'i deb ther dpyid kyi rgyal mo'i glu dbyangs〉las/ shis pa brjod pa'i dbyangs kyi nga ro tam bu ra'i rgyud las nye bar drangs te/ bla na med pa'i ye shes kyi bdud rtsi zad mi shes pa'i 'byung gnas za ma tog dbang gi rgyal bo rmad du byung ba'i thuga~X3 kyi

rig rtsom skad cha'i rigs kyi rnam gnag rin chen rdo 'amigagasang mdzod dpal be'u'i mdzes rgyan du spud pa'i bskal pa bzang bo 'di'i 'dren mchog stobs bcu mnga' ba stong gi mi ltung 'phreng ba'i dbus nas chu shel dbang bo'i dkyil 'khor nya gang ba lta bur mngon par 'phags shing / mda' yis bcings pa'i rlabs po che'i smon lam gyi mthu phul du byung ba'i bden stobs dri ma med pas pad dkar lta bur bsngags pa'i dbyangs kyi rgyal mo'i rnga bo che srid pa gsum gyi khor mo yug tu brdung ba'i rgyal ba bu rum shing pa 'di nyid kyi bstan pa rin po che ni lha dang bcas pa'i 'gro ba'i legs byas grangs med pa'i zong gis bsgrubs pa'i phan bde kun gyi rtsa lag ste/’ zhes pa lta bu tshig lhug red/spel ma ni tshigs bcad dang tshig lhug bsres pa la spel ma zer te/ dper na/ gzhon nu zla med kyi gtam rgyud〉kyi tshig sbyor lta bu'o/ /3 rig rtsom skad cha de don ston tshul gyi cha nas dbye na yid 'gyur mtshon pa'i rig rtsom skad cha dang don gyi nyams brjod pa'i rig rtsom skad cha dang zlos gar rig rtsom skad cha bcas gsum yod/de rnams la rim par dper brjod na/ snyan ngag la 'jug tshul tshig rgyan rig pa'i sgo 'byed〉las/pham bcos lhun gyis grub pa'i brag ri'i spor/ /2 ngo mtshar bkod pas rab mdzes khang bzang ni/ /

sa bcad gnyis pa/ gzhung don dngos gzhi/che zhing dbyibs mtshungs mar gyis brtsigs 'dra ba/ /'di ko mi lam gzugs su grub bam snyam/ /kho ra khor yug ljon shing phreng ba dang / /yid 'ong khyams kyis bskor ba'i bar dag na/ /me tog bzang bo'i bsung zhim 'thul ba yis/ /dri 'dzin lam du sim pa'i dga' ba ster/ /rma bya'i mgrin pa ji bzhin yid 'phrog pa'i/ /sngo ljang ku sha gzhon nu'i lus can rnams/ /bser bus bskyod pas mgo bo 'dud pa dang / /bcas te chu thigs 'thor ba'i rtsed 'jo ston/ /’’zhes pa lta bu yid 'gyur shugs drag rgya mtsho'i rba rlabs 'phyur ba ni yid 'gyur mtshon pa'i rig rtsom skad cha'o/ /don grub rgyal gyis brtsams pa'iṭ+wāṃsprul sku〉las/ a khu nyi ma nam rgyun dang 'dra bar khang ba'i khyams na bal gdan dkar po zhig gi steng skyil krung bcas te ma ṇi 'don bzhin 'dug tsan dan gyi phreng ba g.yu yi mdo 'dzin zhig lag g.yon ma'i gong mdzub dang dkyil mdzub bar du bzung ste mthe bong gis phreng rdog re re bzhin nyug tsam nyug tsam byas te bgrang ba'i mod la/ kha nas oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūṃ zhes yig 'bru gsal bor 'don pa dang / de nas um um zhes sgra sna khung du 'dren pa las tshig gi 'bru mi gsal 25

rig rtsom skad cha'i rigs kyi rnam gzhag rin chen rno 'jigayang / mthe bong gi phreng rdog bgrang tshul la bltas na um sgra re'i nang du'ang ma ṇi yig drug 'dus yod pa shes thub ’ces pa'i skad cha ltar don gyi nyams te a khu nyi ma'i 'dug stangs dang ma ṇi 'don pa'i sgra mig lam du 'char ba dang rna lam du thos rgyu yod pa ni don gyi nyams brjod pa'i rig rtsom skad cha'o/ /zlos gar rig rtsom skad cha ni gling skal bzang legasabashad rgya mtshos mdzad pa'i rā ma na〉las/ ‘khong nas dgod/ /kwa ye nyon cig lus phra ma/ /yangs pa'i nor 'dzin ma yi khyon/ /nga yi 'phrin las gdugs dkar po'i/ /grib bsil gcig gis khyab pa'i srid/ /mig sngar gsal/ spun pa bzhin du 'dor nus na/ /dga' ma'i sgra yi lan bu la/ /chags te gcig tu sdod pa ni/ /nam mkha' gzhan du 'gyur dang mtshungs/ /’ zhes pa'i skad cha lta bu 'gul nyams dang yid 'gyur spel mas phyug pa red/gong smos ltar rig rtsom skad cha ni dbye sgo gsum gyi steng nas rigs dgur phye na bod kyi rig rtsom skad cha'i don dngos dang mthun zhing rgyun srol gyi legs cha'ang bsdu len byas yod do/ /tshang mas shes gsal ltar/ snyan ngag me long ma las snyan ngag la tshig sbyor gyi rnam pa'i steng nas bcad lhug spel ma'i lus gsum du phye yod la/ de gsum gyi steng nas tshig sbyor spel tshul bstan 'dug mod/ 'on kyang de kho nas da yod bod kyi rig rtsom skad cha mtha' 26

sa bcad gnyis pa/ gzhung don dngos gzhi/dag 'doms mi thub ste/ dper na/ zlos gar dang lhug rtsom sogs kyi skad cha'i khyad chos ston mi thub pa dang yul skad dang phal skad dang yig skad kyi rnam gzhag kyang ston mi thub pa lta bu red/de bas/ phan tshun gcig gis gcig gi tshab byed mi thub ste/dper na/ don ston tshul gyi sgo nas phye ba'i rigs gsum gyis tshig sbyor gyi rnam pa'i sgo nas phye ba'i rigs kyi tshab byed mi thub pa dang rang rang la khyad chos yod pa lta bu'o/ /don tshan gnyis pa/ rig rtsom skad cha'i rigs rnams so sor bshad pa/dang po/ yul skad kyi rnam gzhag bshad pa/1 ngo bo dang dbye ba/yul skad ni skad rigs gcig gi nang du tshad ldan skad cha dang khyad par yod cing yul gcig kho nar bkol spyod byed pa'i skad cha la bya'o/ /de rig rtsom la bkol nas spel ba la yul skad rig rtsom skad cha zer/bod kyi rig rtsom skad cha ni yul skad kyi rtsa ba'i cha nas dbye na yul skad chen po gsum yod de/ dbus gtsang gi yul skad dang am skad dang khams skad ces bshad chog 27

rig rtsom skad cha'i rigs kyi rnam gnag rin chen rno 'thagadabus gtsang yul skad ni gtso bo dbus skad dang gtsang skad gnyis kyis grub cing / dbus skad kyi khongs su lha sa dang / phan po/snye mo/ mal gro gung dkar/ chu shur/ kong po/ lho kha sogs kyi skad 'dus pa dang / gtsang skad kyi khongs su gzhis rtse dang rgyal rtse lha ri/ding ri/ sa skya sogs kyi skad 'dus pa yin/a mdo yul skad kyi khongs su kan lho bod rigs rang skyong khul dang dpa' ris rang skyong rdzong / mtsho sngon zhing chen gyi yul shul ma gtogs pa'i bod rigs sa khul dang / sri khron zhing chen gyi rnga ba bod rigs rang skyong khul dang dkar mdzes kyi 'brog khul bcas 'dus pa dang / khams skad spyod yul ni si khron zhing chen gyi dkar mdzes bod rigs rang skyong khul dang / yun nan zhing chen gyi bde chen bod rigs rang skyong khul dang / mtsho sngon zhing chen gyi yul shul bod rigs rang skyong khul/ bod rang skyong ljongs kyi chab mdo sa khul dang nag chu sa khul gyi sa cha 'ga' zhig bcas yin/2 de rnams kyi khyad par/am skad dang dbus skad dang khams skad gsum po'i bar khyad par cung che zhing / de'ang gtso bor yi ge'am sgra gdangs dang ming gi tshogs pa'i steng gi khyad par yin/ sgra gdangs steng nas bshad na/a mdo skad du sngon 'jug dang rjes 'jug gi sgra'i khyad par ha cang gsal la/ yi ge lci ba dang drag po mang / dbus gtsang skad du sngon 28

sa bcad gnyis pa/ gzhung don dngos gzhi/'jug dang rjes 'jug gi khyad par am skad ltar mi gsal yang sgra'i nga ro'i khyad par tsam 'dug la/ sgra 'jam pa dang yang ba mang /khams skad ni phal cher dbus gtsang skad ltar sgra 'jam pa dang yang ba yod kyang / sngon 'jug dang rjes 'jug gi khyad par dbus gtsang dang bsdur na khyad par che ba red/ dbus gtsang skad du ka kha ga nga /zhes ga de kha las cung zad dbugs dro bar 'byin pa dang / am skad du ka ga gnyis phal cher sgra gcig tu 'don te ka yed dang ga zum zhes khyad par 'byed kyin yod pa ltar ro/ gzhan yang / pa pha ba ma rnams la mtshon na/ am skad dang dbus skad/ khams skad du pa pha ma gsum gyi sgra'i 'don stangs gcig la/ ba'i 'don stangs mi gcig ste/ dbus skad du ba la lha zhes pha las dbugs cung dro bar 'byin pa'i tshul gyis 'don zhing / khams skad du pa'i sgra dang phal cher gcig par 'don/ am skad du pa pha ba ma bzhi'i sgra gdangs mi gcig pa'i tshul gyis 'don pa red/yul skad gsum gyi so so'i nang khul du'ang sgra gdangs de 'dra gcig gyur min te/ am skad la mtshon na/ mgo log dang stag tshang lha mo'i phyogs su sra zhes pa la 'don stangs mi gcig ste/ mgo log skad du kra yi gdangs kyis klog pa dang / stag tshang lha mo'i skad du hra yi gdangs kyis klog pa lta bu'o/ /dbus skad la mtshon na/ dbus skad du ba la lha zhes 'don pa 29

rig rtsom skad cha'i rigs kyi rnam gzhag rin chen rno 'thagadang / gtsang skad du am skad kyi pa dang sgra gdangs gcig par klog pa lta bu'o/ /bod skad nang du'ang sgra gdangs gong smos ltar sna tshogs yin pas/ bod skad gcig gyur la gegs chen po bzos yod mod/ 'on kyang sgra gdangs kyi do mnyam pa'i chos nyid med pa min pas/ bdag gi rmongs blor shar tshod ltar na/ mdo dbus khams gsum gyi sgra gdangs zhib 'jug las khungs zhig btsugs te/ yul skad so so'i sgra gdangs kyi chos nyid dang tshul lugs btsal nas bod skad sgra gdangs gcig gyur byed par 'bad na legs snyam/ming gi tshogs pa'i steng nas bshad na/ mdo dbus khams gsum gyi rtsa ba'i ming gi tshogs pa phal cher gcig kyang ming gi tshogs pa mtha' dag gcig mtshungs min/ dbus gtsang skad du dbyin ji dang nyin rdu'i tha snyad g.yar ma mang la/ a mdo'i skad du rgya nag gi tha snyad g.yar ma mang / dper na rlangs 'khor la dbus gtsang skad du mo ṭa dang a mdo'i skad du chi khre zhes pa lta bus mtshon no/ /khams skad du'ang rgya nag gi tha snyad g.yar ma mang ngo / de las 'phros te bshad dgos pa ni/ spyir mi rigs gzhan gyi skad yig gi legs cha blangs na bzang mod/ legs cha len pa'i dmigs yul ni rang gi mi rigs kyi skad yig gong du spel ba las rtsa med du gtong rgyu misdu0 pa de red/ rig gnas gsar brje'i lo bcu'i zang zing nang du

sa bcad gnyis pa/ gzhung don dngos gzhi/nga tsho'i mi rigs kyi skad yig la gnod pa tshabs chen bskyal/ bod skad kyi tshig sbyor bung ba'i gshog sgra lta bu med pa gang mang thon zhing /khyad par du yig sgyur phyogs su don sgyur las sgra sgyur dang thad sgyur mang po byas so/ /deng skabs rang gi skad yig nang du rnyog dra mang po bzos yod pa dag yongs su grags zhes pa'i rgyu mtshan bkod de gtan nas mi 'jog par bsal dgos/ gal te yig sgyur phyogs nas sngon bsam bzhin sgra sgyur byas pa'i ming dang / don sgyur byas kyang go don log pa'i 'gyur skyon can gyi tha snyad mang po yod pa de dag da dung mu mthud du snang med du bzhag na/ tha mar bod kyi skad yig 'di rgya min bod min gyi skad du 'gyur nas rang gi skad yig gi khyad chos yal te rtsa med du 'gro bar gor ma chagade bas/ lo tsā pa dang yig sgyur las khungs dag gis rang gi skad yig gi khyad chos dang bstun nas skad bsgyur byas te/ mi rigs skad yig gi dwangs gtsang la 'bad rgyu ni gnad du che'o snyam/yul/3 yul skad rig rtsom nang du bkol spyod byed pa'i dmigs yul skad ni sa cha zhig gi mi rnams kyis ma gtogs go mi thub pas/ de rig rtsom du bkol spyod byas na chog gam zhe na/ spyir 'os pa min te rig rtsom gyi zhabs 'degs zhu yul ni mi rigs kyi khongasdu1 mi

rig rtsom skad cha'i rigs gyi rnam gzhag rin chen rno 'bigatshang ma red/ yin na'ang / tha snyad tshang ma dang thog sa cha zhig nas byung ste/ phyis su mi rigs kyi khongs mi yongs kyis khas len byas te khyab gdal du song ba'i phyogs nas bltas na bkol dgos par snyam/'o na/ yul skad rig rtsom du bkol spyod byed pa'i dmigs yul gtso bo gang zhe na/ dang po/ brtsams chos kyi mtshon nus la shugs snon rgyag pa dang / gnyis pa/ yul skad so so'i dge mtshan btso sbyong dang mnyam bsres bsdu len byas te gson nus ldan pa'i bod kyi rig rtsom skad cha gsar sgrun byed dgos pa/ gsum pa/ gson nus ldan ṭ+wāṃ'i/ / rig rtsom skad cha gcig gyur dang 'phel rgyas su gtong ba bcas 4 yul skad ji ltar bkol spyod byed tshul/yul skad rig rtsom du ji ltar ba bkol spyod byed dgos zhe na/gdam gses yod pa'i sgo nas bkol spyod byed dgos/ gdam gses kyi tshad gzhi ni phal skad dang yig skad nang du med pa dang phal skad kyis tshab byed mi thub pa gzhir bzung ba'i steng du snang brnyan ldan pa dang / tshig nyung zhing don 'dus pa/ kha gsal zhing go bde ba/gnad la 'khel zhing mdzes chos ldan pa/ tshags dam pa bcas byas na legs pa dang / gzhan du na rig rtsom skad cha phun sum tshogs par gtong mi thub pa phar zhog skad cha gcig gyur sogs kyi phyogs su gnod skyel nges red/32

sa bcad gnyis pa/ gzhung don dngos gzhi/ga// pa/ phal skad kyi rnam gzhag bshad pa/dṛl shād t+na/ yul so so'i thun mong gi skad char go dgos/ ming gzhan la khyab che ba'i skad zer/2 khyad chos/sngon chad mkhas pa rnams kyis phal skad du brtsams pa'i rig rtsom mang zhing da cha'ang rtsom mkhan dag gis phal skad du brtsams pa'i rig rtsom nam mkha'i skar tshogs ltar 'dug mod/ phal skad la yon tan dang skyon gnyis ka yod do/ /yon tan ni/1 don gyi nyams phun sum tshogs pa/phal skad du mngon gyur bye brag gi sgo nas brjod pa phun sum tshogs pa yin zhing / don spyi'i sgo nas brjod pa nyung / dper na stong bsam che ba brjod pa la/ sbal ba na khung nang na yod rung bsam pa gling dkar stod red ces pa lta bu'o/ /2 tshig rno zhing gsal ba/phal skad kyi tshig gi don de gnad la 'khel zhing kha gsal ba yin te/ khab rtse gnyis kyis gos mi tshoms/ blo rtse gnyis kyis don mi 'grub/ /ces pa lta bu'o/ /3 tshig nyung zhing don 'dus pa/ 33

rig rtsom skad cha'i rigs kyi rnam gzhag rin chen rno 'thagaphal skad nang du tshig nyung tsam gyis brjod don tshang bar ston thub pa yod de/ dper na/ sems skyo ba'i mun par ma lhung dang /skyid nyi ma'i 'od zer 'char la nye/ /zhes par tshig nyung nyung tsam las med kyang / sems skyo sdug ma byed dang bde skyid ring min slebs par nye ba red ces pa'i don rdzogs par bstan pa lta bu'o/ /4 bab chags zhing yid du 'ong ba/phal skad du tshig rgyan sogs kyis ma bcings par bab chags shing rang bzhin gyis yid du 'ong ba yod de/ dper na/ mi go ba can la tshig gcig ces pa lta bu'o/ /5 tha snyad gya nom pa/phal skad nang du tha snyad gya nom pa yod de/ dper na/ ngan pa la bkra mi shis pa dang /sna nag ma zhes pa sogs yod pa lta bu'o/ /phal skad kyi skyon cha ni/(1) dus las yol ba'i skad cha/ phal skad las dus dang mi 'tsham par brjod pa'i skad cha yod pa lta bu'o/ /(2) bskyar bzlos mang ba/don gcig la tshig yang yang bzlos pa yod pa lta bu'o/ /(3) tshags mi dam pa/tshig sbyor nang khul du 'brel ba mi dam zhing lhod sha che ba yod pa sdu bu red/

sa bcad gnyis pa/ gzhung don dngos gzhi/gong gsal phal skad kyi skyon yon legs par nges nas gsar rtsom byed tshe 'dor len byed pa gnad du che'o/ /gasnaṭ+wāṃ pa/ yig skad kyi rnam gzhag bshad pa/rdog byed /ni dpe thog tu bkod pa'i skad cha yod tshad la mi go bar/ dpe thog gam yig thog gi tshad ldan skad cha la go dgos/ ming gzhan la bstan bcos kyi skad zer/ dper na/ thon mis rgyal bor phul ba'i yig phud rtsom ste/ ‘‘zhal ras gsal la rang mdangs gang ba bzang / /gdams ngag zam lam ma chad tha dad rang / /las ngan bag chags thams cad bsal mdzad pa/ /'phags pa ma pham yang dag dam pa lags/ /bde legs bden nges ye shes brnyes/ /ting 'dzin zhi nyid rig cing gzigs/ /nyon mongs tshogs bcom mgon po mchog /dus gsum bdud btul kun tu thul/ /’ zhes pa lta bu'o/ /2 khyad chos/yig skad ni ming gi tshogs pa dang tshig sbyor tshul gyi steng nas kha skad dang mi gcig ste/ dper na/ rā ma ṇa'i rtogs brjod las/ ‘dri med zla ba chu shel lhun po khong rab yangs pa dpag tshad bye ba'i khor yug gi /shel gyi rtsig ngos rang 'grogs kyi snang bas skyengs gyur phyi phyir bros shing byer ba ste/ /kha dog lnga yi rin chen ka ba sduyo

rig rtsom skad cha'i rigs kyi rnam gzhag rin rdo 'bigamed btsugs pa'i 'ja' tshon chun pos brgya byin lag pa stong bar byed/ /pho brang khor yug keng shu'i 'bras bus me yis grogs bcas pha gu'i rtsig pa lta ba myos byed grong khyer ro/ /’’zhes pa lta bu tshags dam zhing tshig nyung la don 'dus pa'o/ /de dag bsdus na yig skad la khyad chos 'di rnams yod de/1 mang tshogs kyi go dka' ba/yig skad ni yun ring gi lo rgyus nang du gong 'phel byung ste ming brda dang tshig sbyor phun sum tshogs par song bas mang tshogs kyis go dka' bar gyur yod/ de'i rgyu mtshan gtso bo ni mang tshogs kyi rig gnas chu tshad dma' bar brten nas byung ba red/ gal te bod kyi rig gnas mang tshogs nang du dar rgyas byung na/ mi go ba'i 'phrang de phal cher med/2 brda rnying mang ba/bod kyi skad la 'gyur ba mang du byung ste/ bkas bcad thengs shādṛkā bya/sa/ pa red/ de bas yig skad rig rtsom gyi skad char brda rnying yul skad chen po gsum las gang la gzhir byas te bkas bcad byas zhe na/ gtso bo dbus gtsang gi skad gzhir byas pa red/a mdo'i skad du brda rnying min la dbus gtsang skad du brda rnying du ngesdu pa dper na/ mi la myi dang 'gro la 'gyo zer ba lta bu'o/ /

sa bcad gnyis pa/ gzhung don dngos gzhi/3 bstan bcos kyi skad cha mang ba/bod du nang ba sangs rgyas kyi chos dar ba nas bzung / chos kyi brda mang po bod skad du bsgyur nas bod kyi ming brda phun sum tshogs par btang / dper na/ sems sems byung sogs sems kyi gnas skabs phra mo'ang mtshon pa'i brda dang / 'jig rten chags tshul gyi ming brda lta bu'o/ /khyad par du snyan ngag me long ma dang mngon brjod kyi bstan bcos dag bsgyur bar brten nas rig rtsom skad cha phun sum tshogs pa byung ste/ rnam thos sras kyi mdzod ltar yod do/4 tshig nyung la don 'dus pa/tshig nyung tsam gyis brjod bya tshang bar ston te/ dper na/rdzugazhon nu zla med kyi gtam rgyud〉las/ ‘e ma bsod nams 'chi med ra ba na/ /rigs brgyud dpag bsam dbang bo'i 'khri shing can/ /snyan grags me tog 'dzum pa'i ngo mtshar te/ /khor yug yul ljongs 'di na rnam par bkra/ /’’zhes tshig sdud dang dpe mang po'i py-i /༵/ tshi/ga nyung zhing brjod bya'i don ma 'dus pa med par ston pa 37

rig rtsom skad cha'i rigs kyi rnam gnag rin chen rno 'thagabazhi pa/ tshigs bcad rig rtsom skad cha'i rnam gzhag bshad pa/1 ngo bo dang dbye ba/rkang bas bcad pa la tshigs bcad bya zhing / de la tshig rkang k+ṇi r+sha rdo wa py-ikā /gyi sgo nas dbye na gsham gsal ltar te/ tshig rkang gi bod kyi tshigs bcad rig rtsom skad cha la tshig rkang gi cha nas tshig rkang gnyis can dang gsum can dang bzhi can dang lnga can dang drug can sogs yod kyang / rgyugs che ba ni tshig rkang bzhi can gyi tshigs bcad do/ /(1) tshig rkang gnyis can/de ni tshigs bcad gcig la tshig rkang gnyis yod pa la zer te/dper na/ gtam dpe las/ ‘khyi rus pa'i steng nas 'dzing dang rung / /spyang dar ma'i steng la mnyam rgyug yin/ / zhes pa dang / yang py-i/ brdo// ba/ shad chu yi wu ba/ /lag len gser gyi thigs pa/ /mi’zhes pa ༄(2) tshig rkang gsum can/de ni tshigs bcad gcig la tshig rkang gsum yod pa ste/ dper na/38 dmangs gzhas las/ 5smad kyi mtsho mo rlangs pa can/ /mtsho

sa bcad gnyis pa/ gzhung don dngos gzhi/rlangs pa can la nya sram 'khor/ /yang yang 'khor ba'i smon lam 'debs/ /’’zhes pa dang / yang na/ ‘sha tshon pa'i tshang ra pha mar drongs/ /sha bzhes pa'i pha ma bsod nams che/ /sha 'dren pa'i bu phrug tshe thag ring / / mizhes pa lta bu'o/ /(3) tshig rkang bzhi can/tshigs bcad gcig la tshig rkang bzhi yod pa la zer te/ de dber brjod na/ spyogatam pad ma'i tshal gyi zlos gar/〉las/ sngon chad nyams dga'i 'dod yon/ /da lta sdug bsngal gyur 'dug /da nangs mdzes pa'i rkang drug /da lta ro ru gyur 'dug /’’ces pa dang /yang na/ ṭ+wāṃskya bseng bu lnga'i rtogs brjod〉las/ ‘me tog dra bas khebs pa'i mtshe'u dang / /g.yu yi ljon pa'i yal 'dab la gnas pa'i/ /gnyis skyes mgrin pa kyog nas lta ba ni/ /nags 'dab nyams dga'i dpal la sred pa 'dra/ / ’zhes pa lta bu'o/ /('bye tshig rkang lnga can/de ni tshigs bcad gcig la tshig rkang lnga yod pa la zer zhing /dper na/ gung thang bstan pa'i sgron me'i bslab bya nor bu gling du bgrod pa'i lam yig〉las/snye‘sdig grogs yin zhes rwa can mi 'byung gis/ /gces shing yan pa'i zol gyis 'dzum bstan nas/ /rtse rgod g.yeng ba'i grogs rdid

rig rtsom skad cha'i rigs kyi rnam gnag rin chen rno 'bigabag med kyi/ /las la sbyor te sdig pa'i grogs yin pas/ 'go ba'i nad bzhin ring du spongs shig ang/ /’ zhes pa dang / yang na/dmangs gzhas las/ stag sha ra zhig gi 'dzom gsum bshad/ mgo wa zhwa'i nang na dpa' skad 'dzom/ lag mdzub chung srubs na gri chung 'dzomasapa kha dung so'i bar na rta mgrin 'dzoms/ /stag shar ra zer na de 'dra red/ /’’ces pa lta bu'o/ /(5) tshig rkang drug can/tshigs bcad gcig la tshig rkang drug yod pa la bya ste/ dper na/ dmangs gzhas las/mong 'brong brgya'i gras na yod dus ki /nga 'brong brgya'i dkyil gi rwa dmar yin/ /'brong 'brong gras ma bsdad rdza mtha' bud/ /nga rngo bo zer nas ming zhig btags/ /nga rwa lo zer nas rig sa med/ /'brong rwa kha rgyas na drag gi bsam/ /’ zhes pa dang / yang na/ rje tsong kha ba'i rtag tu ngu'i rtogs brjod〉las/ dwangs shing dri ma med pa'i chu gter steng / /gangs ri'i tog ltar dkar ba'i ngang ba'i tshogs/ /gshog pa zung gis 'dab ma bgrad byas nas/ /tshar du dngar bas khebs par snang ba 'di/ /ston dus lha yi lam ni mdzes byed pa'i/ /sprin dkar phreng ba 'khrigs la 'gran pa bzhin/ / ’zhes pa lta bu'o/ /(6) tshig rkang bdun can/40

sa bcad gnyis pa/ gzhung don dngos gzhi/de ni tshigs bcad gcig la tshig rkang bdun yod pa ste/ dper na/ tun hong gter yig rje 'bangs kyi mgur〉las/ kye gna'i ni thog ma ru/ /gzhe'i ni dang po la/ /dgung sngo ni ma 'og gi /dog mon ya stengs na/ /btsugs btsugs ni btsugs legaste/ /mthos te ni dgung myi rdib/ /dog mon ni sde myi nyams/ /’ zhes pa lta bu'o/ /(7) tshig rkang brgyad can/de ni tshigs bcad gcig la tshig rkang brgyad yod pa can te/dper na/ mi la ras pa'i rnam mgur〉las/ ‘ mi nga dag nga rang mi zer te/ /nga ni dar seng dkar mo'i bu/ /a ma'i mngal nas rtsal gsum rdzogs/ /phru gu'i lo la tshang du nyal/ /thong ba'i lo la tshang sgo bsrungs/ /dar ma'i lo la gangs stod 'grims/ /nga gangs bu yug 'tshubs rung ya mi nga / /brag sa 5 nga sa che rung bag mi tsha/ / ’zhes pa lta bu'o/ /2 tsheg khyim gyi cha nas dbye ba/tshigs bcad la tsheg bar mang nyung gi steng nas phye na/ tsheg khyim gsum can nas so lnga can sogs su yod kyang / lag len la dar che ba ni/ tsheg bar bdun can dang / brgyad can/ dgu can/bco lnga can sogs yin te/ de las 'ga' zung spro na/ 41

rig rtsom skad cha'i rigs kyi rnam gzhag rin chen rno 'thag(1) tsheg bar bdun can/tshigs bcad gcig gi tshig rkang rer tsheg bar bdun yod pa la tsheg bar bdun can zer te/ dper na/ thu'u bkwan blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma'i dbyi ho skyed tshal gyi bsngags brjod〉las/phasbrang rtsis myos pa'i rkang drug rnams/ /pad+ma gser gyi skra can la/ /chags pas lang ling 'khor byed cing / /de yis ngo mtshar dar dir sgrog /’ ces pa lta bu'o/ /(2) tsheg bar brgyad can/de ni tshigs bcad gcig gi tshig rkang rer tsheg khyim brgyad yod pa la zer zhing / dper na/ dge 'dun chos 'phel mi'adu 'bral snying bo med par rtogs pa'i glu〉las/phasrid pa'i 'byor ba la kha'i na bun/ /'dus pa'i snying grogs tshor 'dus mgron po/ /ma nges skyid sdug 'dang gi rming lam/ /bsam zhing bsam na snying po mi 'dug /’’ces pa lta bu'o/ /(3) tsheg bar dgu can/de ni tshigs bcad gcig gi tshigs rkang rer tsheg bar dgu yod pa la bya zhing / dper na/ 'brug pa pad+ma dkar po'i rgyal sras gcung rin po che'i rnam thar〉las/‘‘rab dkar ngang ba'i sde rnams rol ba'i mtsho/ /an+da rnyil ltar sngo zhing rab dwangs pa/ /rgyu skar phreng ba mang pos lus mdzes pa'i /42

sa bcad gnyis pa/ gnung don dngos gzhi/sngo bsangs nam mkha'i bu mo'i rjes su 'gro/mi zhes pa lta bu'o/ /(ci tsheg bar bco lnga can/chigs bcad gcig gi tshig rkang rer tsheg bar bco lnga yod pa la bya ste/ dper na/ 'brug pa pad+ma dkar po'i〈rgyal sras gcung rin po che'i rnam thar〉las/ nyi 'od gser gyi cod paṇa rab bcings na bun ras bal do ker can/ /dbang bo'i gzhu yi do shal rab bkra zla ba chu shel mdangs 'dzin cing / /'bab chu rab dwangs ska rags yid 'ong ne'u gsing gsar bas rmad dkris pa/ /gangs ri bzang bo'i ri bo ya ༵shān/ / thams cad 'dus pa'i gzugs brnyan bzhin/ /’’zhes pa lta sto gzhan rnams 'dir dper 'god pa'i ngal ba mi bya bar gzhan las shes par bya'o/ /tshigs bcad gcig gi tshig rkang rnams kyi tsheg bar mang nyung dang cha mnyam min gyi steng nas dbye na/ tsheg bar cha mnyam pa'i rdo//sa bcad dang tsheg bar cha mi mnyam pa'i tshigs bcad gnyis (1) tsheg bar cha mnyam pa'i tshigs bcad ni/ tshigs bcad gcig gi tshig rkang rnams kyi tsheg bar mang nyung mnyam par ma zad/tsheg bar gyi cha ya'i sdeb sbyor kyang mnyam pa ste/ der dbye na sdung

rig rtsom skad cha'i rigs kyi rnam gzhag rin chen rno 'thagayang grags che ba 'ga' dper brjod na/ sde ba rin spungs pa ngag dbang 'jigs grags kyi zhu 'phrin rig 'dzin pho nya〉las/ dbyar gyi ma mas bstar ba'i sprin dkar khyod/ /lang tsho'i rlan dang bral ba dus kyi chos/ /phyi ma'i don yang legs mod de ltar na/ /byang phyogs ri bo'i phag tu gshegs par mdzod/ / ces pa dang / yang na/ rgyal dbang lnga ba blo bzang rgya mtsho'i 'jam dpal dbyangs kyi bstod pa tasbya ra'i rgyud mangs〉las/ phyogs ris mi ngoms legs par bshad pa'i tshig /lus phra'i 'gram pa'i chang gi thigs pas kyang / /yon tan ba ku la yi kha 'byed pa'i/ /thos pa'i dngos grub stsol cig 'jam dpal dbyangs/ /’’zhes pa lta bu tshig rkang rnams kyi tsheg bar mang nyung dang cha mnyam pa red/(1) tsheg bar mi mnyam pa'i tshigs bcad ni/ tshigs bcad gcig gi tshig rkang rnams kyi tsheg bar mang nyung mi mnyam zhing cha ya'i sdeb sbyor yang mi mnyam pa ste/ dper na/ mi la ras pa'i rnam mgur〉las/‘‘gson dang sring mo pe ta lcam/ /chos gzhon dus snying rus ma byas pas/ /rgas nas byed bsam ci la phan/ /bla ma rje btsun ma bsten pas/ /grogs bzang bla mas ci la phan/ /’’zhes pa lta bu tshig rkang dang por tsheg bar bdun dang / gnyis par tsheg bar brgyad/gasdum pa dang bzhi ba/ lnga ba bcas la tsheg bar bdun yod pas tsheg

sa bcad gnyis pa/ gzhung don dngos gzhi/bar gyi mang nyung mi mnyam pa dang / /tshig rkang gnyis pa'i tsheg bar gyi cha ya rnams tshig rkang gzhan pa rnams kyi tsheg bar gyi cha ya dang mi mnyam pa red/ /3 tshigs bcad rig rtsom gyi skad cha'i nyams spel tshul/tshigs bcad skad cha ni skad cha gzhan dang 'dra bar don dang sgra gnyis kyis grub pa red/ rig rtsom tshigs bcad skad char don gyi nyams dang sgra'i nyams phun sum tshogs pa dgos/ don gyi nyams ni gang zhe na/ tshigs bcad skad cha'i don der dngos yod 'tsho ba'i tshugs ka'am snang brnyan yod pa de la zer zhing / da lta'i rig rtsom snazhu/nga las skad cha'i snang brnyan zhes pa dang phal cher don gcig sgra'i nyams zhes pa ni skad cha'i sgra la 'gyur khug phun sum tshogs pa la go dgos/ da lta'i rig rtsom gzhung las rol dbyangs kyi nyams zhes pa dang don gcig go /(1) tshigs bcad skad cha'i don gyi nyams spel tshul/tshigs bcad skad cha'i don gyi nyams spel tshul rtsa ba'i cha nas dbye na brjod don der dngos po gzhan zhig bkod pa dang mi bkod pa ste rigs gnyis su yod cing / snga ma ni tshigs bcad skad cha'i brjod don der dper bkod pa'i sgo nas don gyi nyams spel ba yin 45

rig rtsom skad cha'i rigs kyi rnam gzhag rin chen rno 'amigazhing / der mtshan gzhi gtso bo 'ga' bzhag na/ dpe'i rgyan dang gzugs rgyan/ bsdus brjod kyi rgyan bcas so/ phyi ma ni brjod don rang gi steng nas don gyi nyams spel ba ste/ de'i mtshan gzhi gtso bo ni rang bzhin brjod pa'i rgyan dang / ngang tshul ston pa'i rgyan/ don rim zab kyi rgyan/ 'bod pa'i rgyan/dri ba'i rgyan bcas yin/ka dpe'i sgo nas don gyi nyams spel tshul/(ka) dpe rgyan ni tshig dngos shugs ci rigs kyis mtshon bya'i don dang mtshon byed kyi dpe gnyis 'dra bar ston pa ste/dper na/rje tsong kha pas/ ‘ring nas smon pa'i rang gi 'dod pa'i don/ /'grub par mthong tshe gzhon nu'i bzhin gyi mdangs/ /zla zer 'thungs pa'i kun da'i tshal bzhin du/ /'dzum dkar 'od kyis lham mer rgyas par gyur//’ ces pa lta bu'o/ /(kha) gzugs can gyi rgyan ni/mchon bya don gyi dngos po de mtshon byed dpe'i dngos po'i gzugs su bkod de rtog bzo byas pa ste/ dper na/ bod mkhas pas/ gang gi mkhyen dasbyod nam mkha'i skyed mos tshal/ /shes bya'i rgyu skar me tog bzhad ldan pa'i/ /legs bshad 'od snang sbrang rtsi'i trīkākā ma/ / tsam/ /thob pa'i blo gsal de dag skal ba bzang / /’ zhes pa ༷(ga) bsdus brjod kyi rgyan ni/

sa bcad gnyis pa/ gnung don dngos gzhi/brjod 'dod kyi dngos po de dngos po gzhan zhig la bsdus pa'am sbas pa'i tshul gyis brjod pa ste/ dper na/ parnyi ta smris tis/ ri bong 'dzin pa rgyu skar phreng ba can/ /mtshan mo mkha' la rgyu ba ma mthong nas/ dwangs pa'i mtsho nang 'di na zla ba zhes/ /gzugs brnyan la zla bar 'dzin pa byis pa'i blo/ / ’zhes pa lta bu'o/ /kha brjod don rang steng nas don gyi nyams spel tshul/(la) rang bzhin brjod pa'i rgyan ni/ brjod don der 'khyog bshad gtan nas ma 'dres par rang gi rang bzhin drang po'i ngag gis gsal bar brjod pa ste/ dper na/ tshidabyangs ldan rig pa'i 'dod 'jo nas/ ’ zhim mngar ldang ba'i rgun chang btung ba 'dis/ /lus kyi 'byung khams dga' bdes khyab pa dang / /kun rtogs yid dbang dran med bzi 'gyur zhing / /rang snang skyid pa'i lab rdol ci yang 'byin/ /’ zhes pa lta bu'o/ /(kha) ngang tshul ston pa'i rgyan ni/ phyi yul gyi dngos po sna tshogs kyi sgra'am gzugs kyi ngang tshul ma nyams par stom pa'i ngag ste/dper na/ mi la ras pa'i mgur 'bum las/ 5brag dmar mchong lung mchong gi rdzong / /steng na lho sprin khor ma khor/ /'og na gtsang chab gya ma gyu/ /bar na rgod po lang ma ling / /rtsi shing sna tshogs ban ma bun/ /ljon shing gar stegs shigs se shigs/ /bung ba glu len kho ro ro/ /me tog dri ngad chi li li/ /bya rnams skad snyan kyu ru ru/ /mi’zhes 47

rig rtsom skad cha'i rigs kyi rnam gnag rin chen rno 'jigapa lta bu'i tshig 'di'i nang du kho ro ro dang kyu ru ru gnyis ni sgra'i skye mched kyi ngang tshul dang / chi li li ni dri'i skye mched kyi ngang tshul dang /gzhan byings rnams gzugs kyi skye mched kyi ngang tshul bstan pa red/(ga) don rim zab kyi rgyan ni/ brjod 'dod dngos pa rnams snga phyi'i rim pa bzhin go rim ma 'dzol bar bsgrigs te go don gyi gting je zab dang rgya je cher gtong ba'i ngag ste/ dper na/ gzhon nu zla med kyi gtam rgyud〉las/ 'jig rten 'di na phan par smra ba ni/ /nyin mo'i skar ma bzhin du ches dkon te/ /de bas kyang ni legs par 'doms pa la/ /nyan par byed pa shin tu dkon par snang / / zhes pa lta bu'o/ /(nga) 'bod pa'i rgyan ni/ dga' sdug skyo mtshar gyi yid 'gyur gang zhig mngon par mtshon slad du 'bod pa'i sgra'am de'i rjes su mthun pa'i ngag tshig gang rung zhig sbyar te brjod pa'i ngag ste/dper na/ gtam pad+ma'i tshal gyi zlos gar〉las/ ‘kye hud kye hud 'jigs shing skrag pa/ /a tsi a tsi glo bur rkyen ngan/ /ci byed ci byed ma rung 'tshe ba/ /'phral du 'di ru bdud po su slebs/ / ’zhes pa lta bu'o/ /(ca) dri ba'i rgyan ni/ brjod don der dri ba'i tshul gyis nyams spel ba'i ngag ste/ dper na/ rgyal dbang bdun pa skal bzang rgya maṭ+wāṃs/ 5gzhan gyis bag zon bya dgos pa'i/ /skyes bu mthu stobs

sa bcad gnyis pa/ gzhung don dngos gzhi/ldan pa su/ /ngag 'jam ran par smra ba dang / /yid ni grim la brtan pa'o/ / zhes pa lta bu'o/ /2 sgra'i nyams spel tshul/bod kyi rig rtsom tshigs bcad skad char sgra'i nyams gtso bor gang dag gi sgo nas thon ce na/ yi ge 'jam tsub kyi sdeb sbyor dang cha ya'i sdeb sbyor/ zung ldan gyi rgyan/ dbyangs gsal nges pa skye gnas nges pa/ rjod bde'am go rim bzlog pa'i sdeb sbyor bcas kyi sgo nas thon pa yin no/ /ka yi ge 'jam rtsub kyi sdeb sbyor ni yi ge 'jam pa dang rtsub pa gnyis legs par bsdebs nas tshigs bcad skad char sgra'i nyams spel ba de la zer zhing / sgra'i nyams la dbye na/ gtso bo rigs gnyis te snyan nyams dang brjid nyams so/ /yi ge 'jam rtsub kyi sdeb sbyor la yi ge 'jam rtsub shes dgos pas/ der rags tsam bshad na/ gsal byed sum cu ni saṃskṛta'i skad ltar rigs 'gre byas na legs te/ ka ga nga ca ja nya ta da na ba ma tsa dza wa 'a ya ra la a ste nyi shu la 'jam pa'i yi ge dang / kha cha tha pha tsha zha za sha sa ha ste bcu la rtsub pa'i yi ge bya'o/ /mgo 'dogs can rnams sgra'i dbang gis sgra drag par 'gyur na rtsub pa dang mi 'gyur na 'jam pa'i yi ge byas na legs so/ /'phul rten rnams rtags 'jug nas gsungs pa ltar 'phul 49

rig rtsom skad cha'i rigs kyi rnam gzhag rin chen rno 'bigarten ming gzhi phan tshun 'phrad tshul gyi dbang gis sgra gdangs drag zhan la ltos nas kyang 'jam rtsub kyi yi ger 'gyur bas rtags 'jug ltar byas na legs par sems te/ dper na/ bkad ces pas ming ṭ+wāṃpy-i /ṭ+wāṃ ṭāsnaṭ+wāṃ sdo/ da/nga phrad pa'i rkyen gyis sgra gdangs drag par yi ge 'jam tsub sdeb sbyor gyi dbang gis 'jam pa'i yi ge mang na snyan nyams dang tsub pa'i yi ge mang na brjid nyams thon pa red/de dag la dper brjod re zung bgyid na/ snyan nyams ni/ thu'u bkwan blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma'isgyuphar phyin drug dang sbyar te skyed tshal la bsngags pa brjod pa〉las/ bung ba'i tshogs rnams rang gi macud/ /ge sar rdul bcas khyer ba la/ /dga' ba'i 'dzum ston pad+mo khyod/ /gtong sems goms pa'i rgyal sras bzhin/ / zhes pa dang /yang na/ dge 'dun chos 'phel gyis/ phakhram dang g.yo sgyu'i rtsed mo dgu sgrig tu byas te/ /'bad pa brgya yis sgrub pa'i 'jig rten gyi 'dun mas/ /yun ring sgug pa'i mtha' la stong bslus su byas pas/ /lo gsum sdug las byas pa'i a thang ni chad song / /7zhes pa lta bu'o/(zhabs kyi gor thig ni yi ge rtsub pa'i rtags so/)bajid nyams ni/dung dkar blo bzang 'phrin las kyis/ yokha char 'tshub pa'i tshang tshing nags tshal khrod/ /sha ba gcan gzan 'phar spyang mchongs shing 'aṭ+wāṃ/ /mtho zhing bajid chags brag gi sa 'dzin rtser/ /bya rgyal rgod

sa bcad gnyis pa/ gnung don dngos gzhi/pa'i gshog 'gyur byed pa mthong / /’’zhes pa lta bu rtsub pa'i yi ge mang ba dang / dbyangs can dgyes glu las/ ‘ tshang tshing kho ra khor yug gi /sra mkhregs sar 'khod skye bo 'ga'/ /thags mkhan tshul mtshungs 'thad 'thad tshig /kha nas mi yongs pha rol tsher/ /’ zhes pa lta bu tsub pa'i yi ge mang pos brjid nyams thon pa red/kha cha ya'i sdeb sbyor/cha ya'i sdeb sbyor zhes pa ni gcod mtshams kyi dbang gis yi ge'i tsheg bar gcig can la ya dang tsheg bar gnyis can la cha zer zhing / de dag sdeb sbyor gyi dbang gis tshigs bcad skad char sgra'i nyams thon par byed pa la go dgos/dper na/ tshangs dbyangs rgya mtsho'i mgur glu las/ yashar phyogs ri bo rtse nas/ /dkar gsal zla ba shar byung / /ma skyes a ma'i zhal ras/ /yid la 'khor 'khor byas song / / zhes pa lta bu tshig rkang rer cha gsum can dang / dge 'dun chos 'phel gyis/ mngon gyur rtags kyi bden pa ngo sprad kyang / /ngam nag bzhin gyi gnyer ma mi sangs pa/ /mdor na phrag dog can gyi skyes bu de'i/ /dga' ba'i dngos po gzhan gyi rgud pa nyid/ /’’ces pa lta bu cha gsum mthar ya gcig dang / yang / ‘thang chen pha mtha' med pa'i dud sprin gyi spris ma/ /rkang gling skad brda bsgyur ba'i rgyus med kyi grogs po/ /kha doṭ+wāṃs

rig rtsom skad cha'i rigs kyi rnam gzhag rin chen rno 'jigasna lnga shar ba'i zhing chen gyi re'u mig /snang yul gang la bltas kyang skyo nyams spyag ༵dug dī/ /’zhes pa lta bu cha bzhi mthar ya gcig dang yang r+sha gabyekā war+sha rnyi byer+sha//tshig sbyor gang du yi ge gzhan gyis bar chod pa dang ma chod pa ci rigs kyi bdag nyid can/ yi ge bskor ba'am bzlas pa la zung ldan bya zhing / de la rtsa ba'i cha nas dbye na bar chod pa dang ma chod pa gnyis yod/ bar chod pa ni/ bskor ba'am bzla bya'i yi ge zung gcig gi ya gnyis kyi bar du yi ge gzhan rnams kyis bar chod pa yin la/ bar ma chod pa ni bskor bya'i yi ge zung gcig gi ya gnyis kyi bar du yi ge gzhan gyis ma bcad pa'o/ /(ka) bar ma chod pa'i rkang ba dang po'i thog mar yod pa/ ‘lam lam 'bar ba ral gri'i rno rgyun gyis/ /kun tu rmongs pa'i dra ba gcod mdzad pa/ /dpal ldan brtan pa'i 'khor lo'i gzi byin gyis/ /blo gros 'dab brgya khong nas rgod par mdzod/ / ces pa lta bu'i rkang ba dang po'i thog ma'i lam lam zhes pa bar ma chod pa'o/ /(kha) bar chod pa'i zung ldan gyi ya gcig rkang ba dang po'i thog ma dang ya gcig gnyis pa'i thog mar yod pa ni/‘ legs bshad nyi ma 'bar ba'i 'od snang gis/ /legs byas dasdupya gyi 'dab brgya bzhad pa na/ /smra ba ngan pa'i ku mu da tshal

sa bcad gnyis pa/ gzhung don dngos gzhi/kun/ /gcig car zum pa'i ngo mtshar e ma rmad/ /’ ces pa lta bu legs dang legs kyi bar chod pa red/(ga) mtha' thog zung ldan ni/ bod mkhas pas/ ‘legs byas rmad byung ri mo bkra ba'i phul/ /phul byung mtshar sdug rgya mtsho'i snying bor smin/ /smin legs ngag gi dpyad 'jo dbyangs can lha/ /lha mchog khyed kyi skye bar rjes thungs shig /’ ces pa lta bu'o/ /nga dbyangs gsal nges pa ni/tshigs bcad gang du dbyangs gsal nges can du byas nas sgra'i nyams thon par byed pa la zer/ de gnyis re re la bzhi bzhi ste brgyad yod do/ de dag las re zung la dper brjod tsam bgyid na/(ka) dbyangs gcig tu nges pa ni/ gung thang bstan pa'i sgron mes/ rtag chad mtha' las 'das pa yang dag lam/ /yang yang bsam pas lta ngan rang lan 'gag /gnad rnams mtha' dag lam lam shar ba na/ /dga' dang dad pas ra gar a la la/ /mi’zhes pa lta bu dbyangs a gcig pur nges pa'o/ /(kha) gsal byed yi ge bzhir nges pa ni/ dmu dge bsam gtan gyis/ ‘la la lung lung le lor lus/ /kha kha kha kher kha khob 'khum/ /gyong gyong gum gum gyog gyog gyos/ /de dag de der dur dur 'dus/ /’’zhes pa lta bu la dang kha/ ga dang da bzhir nges pa red/53

rig rtsom skad cha'i rigs kyi rnam gzhag rin chen rno 'bigaca gnas nges pa/tshigs bcad kyi tshig sbyor gang du yi ge'i skye gnas nges can du byas pa de la gnas nges pa bya zhing / der dbye na bzhi ste/ gnas bzhir nges pa dang gsum du nges pa/ gnyis su nges pa dang gcig tu nges pa bcas so/ de las skye gnas bzhir nges pa ni/ dper na/ dmu dge bsam gtan gyis/phakhong gis bkas mngags gang bkod ngas/ /da lta 'di nas lag tu len/ /pha mtha' bral ba'i pha ma la/ /sha zhen zhe sa yang yang zhu/ /7zhes pa lta bu ni skye gnas mgrin so mchu rkan bzhir nges pa'o/ /cha tshig sdud/tshig dag gi phrad dang yan lag sogs bsdus te tshig gi 'bru nyung ngur bsdus pa la/ tshig rgyas pa'i don rnams ma tshang ba med pa la tshig sdud bya zhing / des tshigs bcad kyi skad char sgra'i nyams thon par byed pa red/ dper na/ mi la ras pa'i rnam mgur las/ gangs dkar te se sgra che yang / /ri mgo kha bas g.yogs pa cig /ma pham g.yu mtsho sgra che yang / /ko mog chu yis gang ba gcig /mi la ras pa sgra che yang / /mi rgan gcer nyal byed pa cig /’ ces pa'i nang gi gangs ri dkar po la gangs dkar zhes khyad gzhi dang khyad chos gzhi mthun par bsdus pa dang / dge steng chab shog phyogs sgrig las/ zhaṭ+wāṃs skyes srid zhi'i zur phud mngon mtho bas/ /mchod 'os bla na

sa bcad gnyis pa/ gnung don dngos gzhi/'dod 'jo'i dpag bsam shing / /dge legs 'od ris mkha' las rnam 'gongs pa/ /rab gsal gdengs ka bsgrirgas pa'i 'be+ebs stegs su/ /’zhes pa'i mngon mtho ni mngon paramatho ba bsdus pa dang / 'o rab gsal ni rab tu gsal ba bsdus pa lta bu ni de nyid bsdus japa ṅge/ /rim bzlog pa/tshigs bcad kyi sgra'i nyams thon slad tshig gi go rim bzlog ste tshig sbyor spel ba la go rim bzlog par bya'o/ ming gzhan la brjod bde'ang zer te/ dper na/ dge bshes shes rab rgya mtshos/ ‘ ngag gi rang bzhin 'dod pa 'jo ba'i ba/ /dbang bo mkhas pa'i khri la 'dzeg pa'i skas/ /nor 'dzin sgeg mo'i rna lung snya na tshog la/ /bu khyod smra ba'i mgrin pa yangs por gyis/ /’ zhes pa lta bu'i nang dbang bo mkhas pa'i zhes pa ni bod skad yongs grags tshig gi go rim ltar na mkhas pa'i dbang bo yin la/ 'dir go rim bzlog ste sgra'i nyams thon par byas pa red/lnga ba/ tshig lhag rig rtsom skad cha'i 1 go don/ rnam gzhag bshad pa/rkang bas ma bcad pa la tshig lhug zer te/ dper na/ sdul

rig rtsom skad cha'i rigs kyi rnam gnag rin chen rno 'jigadabang lnga ba'i deb ther las/ 'chi med bdag po'i ba gam mngon par mtho ba bkra shis sgo glegs grangs med dus gcig tu phyes pa'i zol gyis dge legs kyi 'dod dgu rnam par bkra ba'i sde bzhi'i 'bras bu zad mi shes pa'i bdag po/ ris su ma chad pa'i 'gro ba kun la/ gtong ba'i phyag ring du brkyadīs pa'i dge mtshan che ba'i mi sde srong btsan sgam po/’ zhes bya ba lta ḍi—/tshig sbyor byed tshul/tshigs lhug rig rtsom skad cha'i tshig sbyor spel tshul gtso bo ni tshig sdud red/ de yang gsal por bshad na rnam dbye dang phrad sogs bsdu tshul yin zhing / tshig mdzes zhing snyan pa zhig yin dgos/dper na/ 'dzam bu'i gling du nyi ma lham mer shar nas 'od zer gyi phreng ba spros te kun tu snang bar byas nas pad tshal rnam par rgyas pas dpyid kyi lang tsho dar la babs pa byung ngo / zhes pa la/shar nas spros nas byas nas zhes thams bcad sgra mthun par sbyar la/tshig mi snyan zhing nyog rdzob tu snang ngo / de bas/ yang / 'dzam gling du nyi mas 'od spros/ snang bar byas/ pad tshal rgyas pas dpyid dus byung ngo zhes pa ltar/ tshig gi kha skong dang tshig phrad rnams bsdus pa dang / tshig mtshams snga phyi'i bar so sor gcod mtshams kyi shad re thosdu6 par byas te sbyar na/ don go ba la khyad par med la/ tshig mdzes

sa bcad gnyis pa/ gzhung don dngos gzhi/pa'i rgyan du'ang 'gro'o/ /zhes gsungs 'dug pa lta bu'o/ /drug pa/ bcad lhag spel ma'i rig rtsom 1 ngo bo/ skad cha'i rnam gzhag bshad pa/tshigs bcad dang tshig lhug 'dres mar yod pa la spel ma zer zhing / de ni tshigs bcad dang tshig lhug gi bar mtshams na gnas pa'i tshig sbyor gyi rnam pa zhig yin no/2 dbye ba/der bcad lhug spel tshul gyi go rim steng nas phye na bcad mthar lhug pa can dang / lhug mthar bcad pa can gnyis yod de/snga ma ni dper na/ gzhon nu drug gi rtogs brjod〉las/ ‘dwangs shing gsal ba'i khrus kyi rdzing bu rnams/ /dregs pa'i myos pa'i gnyis 'thung rnams kyis gang / /char sprin sngon po 'khrugs pas rnam rgyas pa'i/ /rgyu skar lam dang 'gran pa bzhin du gyur/ /sngo ljang gos kyis legs g.yogs me tog phreng bas rnam spras nor 'dzin dga' ma can/ /lta na yid 'ong gzugs ldan lo 'dab nor gyis phyug pa'i 'khri shing gzhon nu dag /bser bu'i rdza rngas bskul tshe g.yo ba'i bro gar sgyur ba'i rtse dgar sems g.yeng ba/ /bung ba'i na chung rnams ni dga' ba'i glu yis rnam rol cir yang rab dgar gyur/ /de ltar rdzur

rig rtsom skad cha'i rigs kyi rnam gzhag rin chen rno 'thagaba'i tshe gzhon nu de dag yul gyi bde ba so ma brten par 'dod nas/rang gi khang ba nas phyir byung ste lho phyogs su 'gro bar chas pa dang /lam dang nye ba'i rtsig pa zhig gi drung na skyes bu skyes nas lo brgya lon pa rgas pa'i sdug bsngal mi bzad pa'i khur gyis ches dub pa lus mi sdug cing nyam chung ba yi dwags la 'gran pa lta bu 'dug go’’ces pa lta bu'o/ /lhug mthar bcad pa ni/ dper na/ yang de las/ ‘‘grong khyer de na skyes bu blun zhing le lo'i rang bzhin can/ nyal ba dang / g.yeng ba la dga' ba/ legs nyes dpyod pa'i blo dang bral ba zhig yod pa ste shes pa mi gsal ba de la 'jig rten pa rnams kyis mun pa can zhes btags so/ gang zhig nag po brtsegs pa ltar gnag pa'i/ /mun pas blo mig yongs su bcings ldan de/ /rtag tu gnyid dang snyoms las 'ba' zhig goms/ /blang dor gnas las blo ni phyir phyogs nas//legs pa'i lam ni gang gis mi shes pa/ /de ni nyes pa'i spyod la 'jug par mkhas/ /gtsang sbra med cing dman pa'i las la dga'/ /gdol ba'i bran bzhin de na gnas par gyur/ /’’zhes pa lta bu'o/ /bdun pa/ don gyi nyams brjod pa'i rig rtsom skad cha'i rnam gzhag bshad pa/58 1 don gyi nyams brjod pa'i rig rtsom ni bye brag gi sgo nas phyi

sa bcad gnyis pa/ gzhung don dngos gzhi/yul gyi bya dngos brjod pa dang bkod 'bri byas pa brgyud de btod pa'i snang brnyan yin la/ der bkol spyod byed pa'i skad cha la don gyi nyams brjod pa'i rig rtsom skad cha zhes bya'o/ /der rtsa ba'i cha nas dbye na/ brjod mkhan gyi skad cha dang mi sna'i skad cha ste skad cha rnam pa gnyis su snang / dper na/ gtsug g.yu las/ phasgo yar 'dzul pa dang bcas mar me'i tsha drod kyis gdong tsha hur hur byed pa dang dus mtshungs su sna la mar khu'i dri ma lhang lhang du bro ba'i lha khang zhig gi nang du mchod mes mdun sa khengs shing /sku gzugs yongs rdzogs dar gyis bkab nas tshul ji bzhin mi mngon pa/ mar me'i mdangs kyis dmar ser gyi bzhin la 'phros pas bkrag mdangs dang ldan pa'i khro gtum gyi zhal khyim mthing ga dag ni/ sus mthong yang lus po'i ba spu gyen du gzing bar byed pa'i sku brnyan 'jigs su rung ba zhig gi mdun du/ pha rgan phun tshogs kyis sdong rgan sa la 'gyel ba ltar brkyang phyag gsum 'tshal rjes pus mo'i lha nga sa la btsugs te thal mo spyi bor bkod nas gsol 'di ltar btab bo/ gung thang gi lha mos mkhyen no/ bdag cag ni dal rten mi lus thob kyang skye ba sngon ma tshogs dang bsod nams ma bsags pa'i rkyen gyis da bar sdug dka' las kho na'i ngang mi tshe 'das/ da ni tshe phyi ma'i don phran bu bsgrub phyir gnas skor la yong nas lha sa'i jo bo'i zhal mjal tsam bya rgyu'i 'dun pa kho na 'chang 59

rig rtsom skad cha'i rigs kyi rnam gnag rin chen rno 'thagabazhin pha yul nas thon te dus yun zla ba drug lhag tsam gyi ring la dgon sde dang gnas chen bzhi bcu tsam bskor zin pa dang / da ni lha mo khyed kyi sku gam du lhags/ sang nyin sa ga zla ba'i tshes chen bco lnga la jo bo'i zhal ras mjal rgyu'i dus su slebs/ lha mo khyed kyis nga pha bu gnyis la de'i bar bar chad mi 'ong ba'i skyabs 'jug ci nas kyang yod pa zhu zhes smon lam btab rjes/ pha rgan phun tshogs kyis pus mo'i 'gram nas 'khar ba blangs te ga ler yar langs rjes rang gi g.yon phyogs su blangs pa'i bu lo chung zhig gi dpung ba'i thog tu lag pa g.yon ma bzhag thog yang yang phyi mig lta bzhin du lha khang gi phyi rol du thon/mi’zhes pa'i tshig sbyor gyi sgo yar 'dzul ba nas gsol ba 'di ltar btab bo zhes pa'i bar dang / yang zhes smon lam btab rjes zhes pa nas lha khang gi phyi rol du thon zhes pa'i skad cha ni brjod mkhan gyi skad cha yin la/ pha rgan phun tshogs kyis gsol ba btab pa'i skad cha ste gung thang gi lha mos mkhyen no zhes pa nas skyabs 'jug ci nas kyang yod pa zhu zhes pa'i skad cha ni mi sna'i skad cha red/2 rjod mkhan gyi skad cha dang mi sna'i skad cha/1 rjod mkhan gyi skad cha/(1) rjod mkhan gyi skad cha'i go don dang dbye ba/rjod mkhan gyi skad cha ni rtsom mkhan gis gtam rgyud bshad pa 60

sa bcad gnyis pa/ gzhung don dngos gzhi/dang / mi sna bkod 'bri byed pa/ don dag gsal bshad dang khor yug ris su 'be+ebs pa/ bgro gleng byed pa dang yid 'gyur mtshon pa'i skad cha la zer/ der tshig sbyor gyi rnam pa'i steng nas dbye na bcad lhug spel ma gsum yod cing / de las tshig bcad ni dper na/ra ma ṇa'i rtogs brjod las/ 'od kyi dra ba'i lding khang na/ /dpal mo chu yi ma ma can/ /lta byed dkyus ring ut+pal zung / /zil ba 'god pa'i ci yang brel/ /’’zhes pa lta bu'o/ /tshig lhug ni dper na/ klong chen rab 'byams pa'i dri med 'od zer po ta la kun tu dga' ba'i gtam las/‘‘rtsa ljang ser gyi myu gus khyab pa'i sa phyogs skye shing sna tshogs kyi ljon pas bskor zhing / me tog gi tshal na bung ba snyan par sgrogs pa'i gzhir yid gar 'ong ba'i chu pad+ma'i dra bas khebs par/ ngur ba mang pos glu len zhing khrung khrung bde bar rgyu ba'i rdzing bu shin tu dga' ba zhig na/ ngang ba'i rgyal po tshul khrims dang / ting nge 'dzin dang / mang du thos pa rgya mtsho'i chus brlan par byas pa zhig kyang 'dug par gyur to’ zhes pa lta bu'o/spel ma ni dper na/ gzhon nu drug gi rtogs brjod las/ ‘de nas zhal gyis ston gyi dus su gyur to/ de'i tshe shin tu yid 'ong ston gyi dus/ /bsod nams rdzogs pa 'gro ba rnams la 'byung / /nor 'dzin bdag po skye rgu thams cad la/ /ci 'dod sbyin pa'i mchod sbyin 61

rig rtsom skad cha'i rigs kyi rnam gzhag rin chen rno 'khriga'agyed pa bzhin/ /’’zhes pa lta bur lhug mthar bcad pa dang / yang na bcad mthar lhug pa gang rung byas chog go/(2) mtshon stangs gtso bo 'ga'/brjod mkhan gyi skad cha la phyogs mang po'i sgo nas sgyu rtsal gyi nyams btod pa'i nus pa dang ldan pas mtshon stangs sna tshogs yod kyang gco bo 'ga' bshad na gsham gsal ltar/ka brjod 'god can gyi skad cha/de ni spyir btang du cung thad kar bab chags pa'i sgo nas mi sna'i bya byed tho 'god dang / mi sna'i byung rabs/ don de'i brgyud rim sogs phyogs bsdus kyis brjod pa'i phyogs su bkol ba'i skad cha ste bab chags pa dang / kha gsal zhing go bde ba ni de'i blang bya yin/ ltos 'jog gi sgo nas bshad na/ snang brnyan ldan pa'i rang bzhin/ gson nyams ldan pa'i rang bzhin dang / yid 'gyur mtshon pa'i rang bzhin sogs kyi steng nas ha cang mngon pa mi gsal te/dper na gtsang smyon sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan gyi mi la ras pa'i rnam mgur las/ ‘de nas nga lo bdun tsam 'gro ba'i tshe/ yab mi la shes rab rgyal mtshan de skung gzhi drag po rang zhig gis zin nas/ sman pa dang mo ma rnams kyis mi 'tsho bar lung bstan cing / gnyen nye 'brel rnasdu~X kyang mi 'tsho bar shes/ khong rang yang ma 'tsho bar kho thag chod

sa bcad gnyis pa/ gzhung don dngos gzhi/nas/ a khu dang a ne la sogs gnyen nye ring grogs dga' bshes yul mi khyim mtshes drag pa kun bsags te/ bu smad nor dang bcas pa bcol gtam byas nas/ mthar pha shul bu 'dzin du 'jug pa'i kha chems yi ge rgyas par byas te/ kun gyis thos par bsgrags/’ zhes pa lta bu bab chags shing go sla la/ thad kar phyogs bsdus kyis brjod pa'i skad cha'o/ /kha 'bri 'god can gyi skad cha/'bri 'god can gyi skad cha ni tho 'god mi byed par bye brag gi sgo nas don dngos kyi nang don ris su 'bebs pa dang brjod pa ste/der tshad mthon po'i snang brnyan rang bzhin dang / gson nyamaspu rang bzhin ldan par ma zad/ yid 'gyur mtshon pa'i grub cha'ang yod de/ dper na gtsug g.yu las/ ‘sku ngo mda' dpon nas dus ston dbyar gyi dpal yon gyi ngo mtshar rnams la 'dren byed kyi longs spyod byed bzhin par skyed tshal gyi gseb nas mdun du phyogs pa na/ ljon shing gi ra bas bskor ba'i dbus su yan lag brgyad ldan gyi mtshe'u dwangs shing gtsang ba zhig 'dug pa de'i 'gram du lhags te tsan tan gyi sdong bo zhig gi zur nas bltas pas/ in+d+ragli la'i mdangs dang ldan la ngos me long ltar snyoms pa'i mtshe'u'i nang du bya ngur ba'i tshogs rnams khyo shug cha re bzhin mnyam gshib kyis 'tsho zhing gnas pa'i mjug rdzogs na sdugo

rig rtsom skad cha'i rigs kyi rnam gzhag rin chen rno 'bigal zhwa mo lcags mda' gyon zhing / lus po mdzod gos ser po'i mtshal phyu mas legs par bklubs pa/ rkang ba gzha' tshon gyi ris ltar bkra ba'i lham 'ja' chen gon pa/ rna bar 'od lham me bar 'tsher ba'i gser g.yu mu tig las grub pa'i sog byil dpyangs pa'i mtshar sdug can zhig mtsho khar me tog 'thu bzhin pa mthong /mi zhes pa lta bu yul ljongs dang mi sna'i gzugs ris bye brag gi sgo nas ris 'be+ebs byas pa brgyud de mig lam du 'char rgyu yod pa'o/ /ga dpyad brjod can gyi skad cha/dpyad brjod can gyi skad cha ni cung zad shugs drag pa'i sgo nas thad kar brjod mkhan gyi bsam blo lta tshul dang yid 'gyur skyes phyogs mtshon pa'i skad cha yin te/ dper na/ rā ma ṇa'i rtogs brjod las/ legs bshad sgra la rnam dpyod can/ /mkhas pa nyid do co 'dri'i tshig /mdza' bo'i gnad du bsnun pa la/ /blun po las ni mkhas pa su/ /’mizhes brjod mkhan gyis thad kar sī tā blun par bstan to/ /2 mi sna'i skad cha/(1) mi sna'i skad cha'i go don dang dbye ba/rig rtsom ba rtsams chos nang gi mi sna'i brjod gtam dang tshig laṭ+wāṃ4 sogs la mi sna'i skad cha zhes bya ste/ der tshig sbyor gyi rnam pa'i

sa bcad gnyis pa/ gzhung don dngos gzhi/steng nas dbye na/ gtso bo ni tshigs bcad dang tshig lhug gnyis su phye ba ste/ de las tshig bcad ni dper na/ rdza cig gtam rgyud las/ e ma khyod ni bya yi drang srong ste/ /srog bcad spangs shing byams pa'i ngang tshul can/ /gnyen la mi chags su byams pha ma dang / /yul la ma chags gang skyid pha yul mdzad/ /khyed kyi spyod tshul la ni bdag nyid mos/ /nga ni skyo ba'i ngang tshul cung tsam zhu/ /las kyi dbang gyis snyigs ma'i dus 'dir skyes/ /kun dang bstun na dam pa'i chos dang 'khon/ /chos mthun gnas na kun gyis brnyas dmod byed/ /chos la 'bungs na mtho dman dgra ru langs/ /dma' sa bzung na snyom chung mtha' la 'bud/ /phar la phan btags tshur la gnod ngan byed/ /snyigs mas log sgrub bdag gis mi bzod pas/ /chags med rgyal khams myur bar bdag nyid mos/ /’ zhes pa lta bu'o/ /tshig lhug ni gzugs kyi nyi ma'i rnam thar las/ yab sgom chen gyis gzugs kyi nyi mar smras pa ste/ bu mo snyigs ma'i dus kyi mi rnams ni dbyen dang khra ma la dga'/ nag po'i phyogs kyi bdud dang /'gong po pe har rnams ni mthu rtsal che/ khyod bud med kyi rigs kha mang zhing / klad pa chung bas bar chad 'byung nyen yod pas/ /srung ba 'di dang ma bral bar gyis/ 'di dang ma bral na mi dang mi yin pa gang gis kyang glegs rnyed par mi 'gyur ro 'di su la'ang ma ston/snying nye ba'i rgyal po la'ang ma ston cig /sha khrag nas chad pa'i bu 65

rig rtsom skad cha'i rigs kyi rnam gzhag rin chen rno 'thagadang bu mo la'ang ma ston cig ces pa lta bu'o/ /(2) mi sna'i skad cha'i khyad chos/mi sna'i skad cha ni don gyi nyams brjod pa'i rig rtsom du mi sna'i rang gshis bkod 'bri byed pa'i thabs zhig yin/ de'i khyad chos gtso bo ni rang gshis can no/ /dper na/ mi la ras pa'i rnam thar las/ yum skyang tsha dkar rgyan gyis yab mi la shes rab rgyal mtshan khyed la bu 'di 'dra skyes so/khyod rabs chad par gda' ba/ nged ma smad kyi las bskos la gzigs dang / zhes pa lta bu myang tsha dkar rgyan chags sdang rus su thon pa'i rang gshis de mtshon pa red/brgyad pa/ yid 'gyur mtshon pa'i rig rtsom skad cha'i rnam gzhag bshad pa/1 yid 'gyur mtshon pa'i rig rtsom skad cha'i go don dang bcad chos/rtsom mkhan gyis rang gi yid 'gyur te dga' skyo/ chags sdang sogs kyi rba rlabs phyir mngon par mtshon pa'i tshig sbyor la bya ste/ de la khyad chos gang yod ce na/ rtsa ba'i khyad rtags gnyis yod de/ yid 'gyur tshon mdangs rngams mthug pa dang / rang snang yul can gyi mdīn gsal rang bzhin no/ snga ma ni dper na/ dge bshes shes

sa bcad gnyis pa/ gzhung don dngos gzhi/rab rgya mtshos/ snying nas dran pa'i gsol 'debs gling bu'i gdangs/ /dad gus sor rtses ldem por bsgyur ba ni/ /ngo mtshar dpag yas yid dga' chos 'dzin nas/ /yab gcig 'jam dpal snying bos gsan du gsol/ /mi zhes pa lta bu'i nang rtsom mkhan gyis rang gi yid 'gyur yod tshad phyungs ste rtsom tshig gi nang du bkol ba ste/ de las shes thub pa ni yid 'gyur gyi tshon mdangs rngams 'thug ldan pa ni yid 'gyur rig rtsom skad cha'i khyad rtags zhig red/phyi ma ni dper na/ bis mdo'i rgya nag gi mkhar mo che ya rdzi la zhang btsun bstan pa rgya mtsho dang 'jigs med rigs pa'i blo gros gnyis kyis so sor mdzad pa'i ljags rtsom de dag gi steng du mngon par gsal/ zhang btsun bstan pa rgya mtshos/ gnas de nas byang du bgrod tsa na/ /lam brag 'phang bar do'i 'phrang ring 'dra/ /thang skam po rtsa med chung med pa/ /yul kla klo'i grong khyer du mas gang / /ri sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'dra/ /mi dbul bo yi dwags mngon sum bzhin/ /sa rtse gzhung skyid pa'i sman ljongs dran/ /dus de ring dmyal bar skyes sam snyam/ /gzhung sher phyin mdo las gsus pa ltar/ /zhing sbyong ba'i smon lam yang yang btab/ /’ ces pa dang /'jigs med rigs pa'i blo gros kyis/ ‘sa la 'bru drug snye ma g.yur du ldem/ /btsug pa'i ljon par shing tog khur gyis dud/ /brtsigs pa'i ra bar sngo tshod bca' bas gtams/ /zas nor longs 67

rig rtsom skad cha'i rigs kyi rnam gzhag rin chen rno 'thagaspyod klu dbang mdzod la 'gran/ /cha byad skad rigs rnam bzhi'i skye bo yis/ /grong dang grong khyer mtshar sdug rab mdzes shing / /lta na sdug pa'i khang bzang skar tshogs ltar/ /bkram pa 'di dag yul grong gang zhig lags/ /'di ni lha yul sa la 'phos pa min/ /klu yul pho brang sgo glegs phye ba'ang min/ /sngon bsags bsod nams bzang po'i 'bras bu la/ /bdag gis zhing der mi lus rin chen rnyed/ /’ ces pa'i snyan rtsom snga phyi gnyis ka'i nang du gcig gis smad pa dang gcig gis bstod pa byas pa'i rang snang yul can gyi rang bzhin gsal por mngon pa bzhin no/ /2 yid 'gyur mtshon pa'i skad cha'i thabs tshul/rig rtsom gyi yid 'gyur mtshon pa'i skad cha de thabs tshul gang 'dra brgyud de bsam pa'i 'gyur bag mtshon nam zhe na/tshig gis rtsom mkhan gyi yid 'gyur mtshon pa'i rnam pa'i steng nas bltas na/ yid 'gyur mtshon pa'i skad cha la yid 'gyur mtshon lugs mi 'dra ba du ma yod de/ yid 'gyur tshig ngos na gnas pa dang yid 'gyur tshig khog na gnas pa/ yid 'gyur tshig phyi na gnas pa bcas so/ /yid 'gyur tshig gi ngos na gnas zhes pa ni skad cha'i bsam blo'i brtse dung mtshon pa ha cang mngon par gsal zhing yig 'bru maṭ+wāṃng ma thag nges thub pa'o/ /de la yid 'gyur yig don la gnas
