sa bcad gnyis pa/ gzhung don dngos gzhi/pa'ang zer chog snyam/go don dper brjod ni/ dge bshes shes rab rgya mtshos/ ‘dbang dang go sa 'byor ba'i dar rgud/ /glog gi bu mo 'khyug pa'i gar dang / /zo chun 'khor lo'i bla 'og bzhin du/ /nges med skad cig ma 'dir ltos dang / /gsungs pa'i bka' la brjed pa ma mchis/ /bka' drin gsum ldan shes rab rgya mtshos/ /smra ba'i seng ge'i byin gyis rlobs shig /’ ces pa dang / rdo grub 'jigs med bstan pa'i nyi mas/ / ‘nags ljon shing phreng bas mdzes rgyan du byas shing / /gtsug ri bong 'dzin pa la thod du bcings pa'i/ /grogs nyon mongs med pa'i mdzes sdug gi lhun po/ /lus mi gtsang gze ri'i sdigs pa dang 'dra'am/ /g.yu'i mdzes pa 'gog pa'i ljang gsal gyi 'khri shing / /rlung shin tu 'jam pa'i bsil chab kyis bskul tshe/ /lus bsil ba'i reg byas lan brgya ru sim byed/ /khyed mi chen dgyes pa'i rnga yab kyis e 'gran/ /gnas ma bcos lhun grub rdo leb kyi khang bzang / /chod phug phug du ma'i mdzod khang med de/ /nor chog shes bsogs pa'i 'dzad med kyi gter chen/ /'di kun mkhyen brgyud pa'i gsog rdzas kyi pha khang / /mdangs shin tu gsal ba'i na chung gi grogs mos/ /lha mig stong dbang bo'i rgyud mangs la 'gran pa'i/ /skad yan lag brgya ba'i 'jo sgeg dang 'grogs nas/ /yid thar bas bskul ba'i pho nya de dran byung / /’’zhes pa lta bu yid 'gyur mtshon pa 69

rig rtsom skad cha'i rigs kyi rnam gnag rin chen rno 'amigaha cang gsal zhing yig 'bru mthong ma thag nges pa ster ba red/yid 'gyur tshig khog na gnas zer ba ni/ tshig gis rtsom mkhan gyi bsam blo brtse dung de phyi la de 'dra mngon par mi 'jug kyang /tshig don dang kha yang 'bral med/ ming gzhan la yid 'gyur tshig shugs na gnas pa zer/ de'ang dper na/ rā ma ṇa'i rtogs brjod las/ kun gsal mngal las bde sogs kyi/ /bdag po'i gzhu ni nyer longs pa/ /mig stong rang gi lag pa yi/ /mtshon cha gzhan la dga' ba med/ /nyi ma rang gi grogs mo ni/ /srin po'i grong na 'dug pa de/ /ma bzod rgya skyegs 'dzin ma la/ /tsha zer 'gyed phyir rings bar 'ongs/ /7zhes pa lta bu tshig dngos las sī ta'i mdzes pa la ༵ñtsād/ / pa byas med na'ang tshig shugs las ches cher bstod pa mdzad yid 'gyur tshig gi phyi na gnas zer pa ni/ rtsom mkhan gyis mtshon 'dod pa'i bsam blo brtse dung de yig thog na med cing / yi ges bye brag ris su phab pa'i nang du'ang mi 'dus par dngos po gzhan la bcol ba'am sbas pa la bya'o/ de'i go don dper brjod ni/bod mkhas pas/ ‘lus grims rkang ba brgyad pa'i sha tshugs kyis/ /dus kun garjo lar 'gying rngam rngam 'dra/ /don gyi bya bar zhugs tshe be+em po'i dngos/ /de 'drar mtshar du 'dzin rnams byis pa'i blo/ / ’zhes pa lta bu bsam bya de mkhas min gyi bla ma chen po de dngos po 70

sa bcad gnyis pa/ gnung don dngos gzhi/gzhan te seng ge rkang ba brgyad pa'i gzugs can gyi rang bzhin la bcol ba'am sbas pa'o/ /rtsom mkhan gyis yid 'gyur mtshon pa'i phyogs nas yid 'gyur mtshon pa'i skad cha'i mtshon stangs la bltas na/ yid 'gyur dngos su mtshon pa'i skad cha dang yid 'gyur brgyud de mtshon pa'i skad cha ste rigs gnyis su dbyer rung / yid 'gyur dngos su mtshon pa'i skad cha ni rtsom mkhan la phyi yul bya dngos kyis yid 'gul thebs te bkod 'bri bya yul la kha gtad de sems khong gi yid 'gyur thad kar phyir mtshon pa red/ de'ang dper na/ thu'u bkwan blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma'iṭ+wāṃdabyangs can ma'i bstod pa〉las/ kun gyi mdzes sdug bsdus nas bdag gir byas/ /drag po'i gtsug rgyan brkus nas gdan du btings/ /blo gsal gzhon nur 'grogs pa'i bag yangs can/ /tshangs pa'i bu mo khyod la zhe nas khrel/ /’ zhes pa lta bu dbyangs trīsdo/ ma'i khyad chos phul du byung bar yid 'gyur thad kar mtshon pa yid 'gyur brgyud de mtshon pa'i skad cha ni rtsom mkhan la 'tsho ba dngos kyis yid 'gul thebs zhing yid 'gyur mtshon pa'i skad cha dang gcig kyang / rtsom mkhan gyis yid 'gyur thad kar mi mtshon par dngos po gzhan la bcol ba'am sbas nas mtshon pa'o/ /bo dong ba phyogs las rnam rgyal gyis/ rin chen skyed mos tshal gyi mtsho 71

rig rtsom skad cha'i rigs kyi rnam gzhag rin chen rno 'biga'agram dang / /dri med nor bu'i ljon shing 'phreng ba can/ /shel gyi lcug phran 'khri shing gzhon nus 'khyud/ /phan tshun yal ga lag pas 'then pa 'dra/ /gser gyi me tog rnams ni mgo spyog ldem/ /g.yu yi bung ba glu len 'phur zhing lding / /ngang ba'i rgyal po mtha' yas rdza rnga brdungs/ /bzhad dkar mgrin ring rnams ni sil snyan sgrogs/ /myos pa'i khu byug zab mo'i gling bu bsgyur/ /nags kyi bye'u sna tshogs pi wang sgrogs/ /chu bya mtha' yas dga' zhing rnam par 'phyo/ /spu sdug ri dwags rnams ni rgyug cing mchongs/ / zhes pa ni bye brag gi sgo nas yul ljongs ris su phab pas yul ljongs 'bri ba dang don gyi nyams brjod pa'i skad cha bkol yod pa 'dra na'ang / don dngos su rtsom mkhan gyi yul ljongs la bsngags pa byas te rang gi spro ba'i sems dang yul ljongs la dga' ba mtshon pa red/ 'di 'dra ba'i yid 'gyur mtshon pa'i skad cha la ljongs tshig brgyud de yid 'gyur gyi skad cha spel ba bya'o/ /gzhan yang / rtsom 'ga' zhig la bltas na gnas lugs ston pa 'dra yang don dngos su yid 'gyur mtshon pa'i skad cha zhig yin te/dper na/ tshangs sras bzhad pa'i sgra dbyangs las/ mdza' ba snying la 'khyud pa'i smin legs gang / /glo bur bral ba'i sdug bsngal gnon par dka'/ /slar yang sgeg 'dzum nyams rgyas dga' ma dang / /lhan du ṭ+wāṃn pa'i dga' ba gnon par dka'/ /’ zhes pa lta bu ni mtshan

sa bcad gnyis pa/ gzhung don dngos gzhi/nyid rig pa'i gnas lugs yod kyang gnas lugs ston pa gtso bo min par ngar gi dga' ma la bcangs pa'i brtse dung ngam yid 'gyur zab mo de mtshon pa gtso bo red/3 yid 'gyur mtshon pa'i rig rtsom skad cha'i thun min gyi mtshon stangs/yid 'gyur mtshon pa'i rig rtsom skad cha'i thun mong ma yin ༵trī /mtshon stangs de gsham gsal gyi phyogs 'ga'i steng nas mngon gcig sgra'i nyams 'gyur thad/ sgra'i nyams 'gyur gyi phyogs nas yid 'gyur mtshon pa'i rig rtsom skad cha de skad cha gzhan dang mi 'dra ste/ yid 'gyur mtshon pa'i rig rtsom skad cha la nges can gyi sgra'i 'gyur khug phun sum chogs pa zhig yod pa ste/ de tshig gzhan nas bshad na/ rol dbyangs rang bzhin 'bur du thon pa yod de/dper na/ rje tsong kha bas/ ‘brtags nas tshad mas bsal ba dang / /tha snyad snang tsam ma 'gags pas/ /rtag chad mtha' las rab 'das ༵ kā/sa /༵t+yā/ da/ga lam la mkhas pas bshad/ /’ ces pa lta bu dbyangs gnyis/ tshig gi sgrig tshul gyi thad/ tshig gi sgrig tshul lam brda sprod tshul gyi phyogs nas spyir btang gi brda sprod kyi tshul lugs dang mthun dgos mod/ 'on kyang yid 'gyur mtshon pa'i rig rtsom sdud

rig rtsom skad cha'i rigs kyi rnam gzhag rin chen rno 'thagacha'i brda sprod tshul lam sgrig tshul la dmigs bsal gyi phyogs yod pa red/de'i mtshon tshul gtso bo gsham gsal ltar te/(1)tshig gi yan lag sogs bsdus pa/de la rnam dbye dang tshig phrad tshig gi kha skong sogs bsdus pa'i rnam pa mang yang 'dir dper brjod cig bkod na/rnam dag gangs ri ma las/ ‘rnam dag gangs ri'i phreng bas yongs bskor ba'i/ /phyogs 'dir bdag cag mgon med rnams kyi gamon/ / zhes pa'i nang du rnam par dag pa la rnam dag dang /yongs su bskor ba la yongs bskor/ mgon po med pa la mgon med ces bsdus pa lta bu'o//(2)tshig gi go rim bzlog pa/de ni yid 'gyur mtshon pa'i rig rtsom nang du yid 'gyur shugs drag mtshon pa dang / cha ya'i sdeb sbyor 'grig pa'i ched du spyir btang gi tshig gi 'gros sam tshig gi go rim bzlog ste sbyar ba'o/ /dper na/ snang sa 'od 'bum gyi rnam thar〉las snang sas/ ‘skyabs su mchi'o bla ma dkon mchog gsum/ /byin gyis rlobs shig yi dam mkha' 'gro tshogs/ /bar chad sod cig chos skyong srung ma rnams/ /bu mo'i bsam pa chos bzhin 'grub par shog / ces pa'i tshig 'di'i nang gi skyabs su mchi'o dang byin gyis rlobs shig bar chad sod cig ces pa ni yongs grags kyi tshig gi go rim ltar na/ bla ma dkon 74

sa bcad gnyis pa/ gzhung don dngos gzhi/mchog gsum la skyabs su mchi'o/ /yid dam mkha' 'gro'i tshogs kyis byin gyis rlobs/ /chos skyong srung ma rnams kyis bar chad sod cig ces sbyor dgos kyang / 'dir snang sas bla ma dkon mchog gsum la dad pa shugs drags pa'i sgo nas gsol ba btab pa dang /yi dam mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma rnams la bskul ba nan tan byed pa'i tshul de 'bur du btod pa dang cha ya'i sdeb sbyor 'grig pa'i ched du go rim bzlog ste brjod pa red/(3)tha snyad kyi ngo bo bsgyur ba/ tha snyad dam ming gang dang gang la rang gi ngo bo dang byed las nges can zhig yod de/ de'ang dngos po'i ming dang bya ba'i ming / khyad chos kyi ming dang grangs ka'i ming lta bur mtshon na rang gi ngo bo dang byed las mi mtshungs pa ltar ro/'on kyang / yid 'gyur mtshon pa'i rig rtsom nang du rtsom mkhan gyis yid 'gyur mtshon pa'i dgos mkho gzhir bzung ste/ tha snyad kyi ngo bo bsgyur te bkol chog go /de'i go don la dper brjod cig bgyid na/dngos po'i ming dang tshab ming ni bya ba'i ming du sbyar ba ni gru gu go rdzong las/ yul dang phu 'brog mda' zhing gsum/ /bdag rgyu yin nam bskyur rgyu yin/ /’’zhes dang / rgya gar dri med 'od dkar de/ /lan dri ngan pas ma dgra gong / /bum chung rgyan du phul na bsam/ /dgos pa'i dus su ma mchod na/ /gling ge sar min pa'i rtags la zhog /brel ba'i dus su ma mgon na/ /lha mthu chen min pa'i rtags la 75

rig rtsom skad cha'i rigs kyi rnam gzhag rin chen rno 'thagazhog’ ces pa lta bu gnyis kyi nang gi snga ma'i bdag rgyu zhes pa ni bdag gi mi sna dang po mtshon pa'i ming ste nga zhes pa'i don yin la tshab byed kyi ming ste/ 'dir de bya ba'i ming du sbyar ba ste bdag gnyer byed pa'i bya ba mtshon byed du 'jug go /phyi ma'i ma dgra zhes pa'i dgra ni rang phyogs la gnod pa'i dgra bor 'jug cing / dngos po'i ming yin/ 'dir de bya ba'i ming du sbyar te/ dgra bo byas pa'i bya ba mtshon pa la 'jug go /ma mgon zhes pa'i mgon ni dngos po'i ming ste mgon po zhes pa yin zhing / 'dir de bya ba'i ming du sbyar te mgon skyabs byed pa'i bya ba mtshon pa la 'jug pa'o/ /gsum/ don ston tshul gyi thad/ yid 'gyur mtshon pa'i rig rtsom skad cha ni rtsom mkhan gyis rang gi yid 'gyur mtshon par bkol ba'i skad cha yin pas/ rtsom mkhan gyis gsar rtsom go rim nang du rang gi yid 'gyur tshad med pa de tshad can gyi rig rtsom nang du mi shong ba dang / dus mtha'i me ltar 'bar ba'i yid 'gyur de rgyun par 'phar chag gi 'gyur ldog gi nang du gnas par brten/ sgyu rtsal gyi bkod sgrig byed dgos pa ste/ sgyu rtsal gyi bsam bkod de skad cha'i steng du bkol na don ston thad tshul 'phur mchongs byung ba red/dper na/ ‘'dzam gling skyid pa'i nyi ma/ /dwags pa'i nang nas shar soX6 / /rdo ring lha lcam sku zhabs/ /rkub la dud dregs chags song / /’’

sa bcad gnyis pa/ gzhung don dngos gzhi/zhes pa lta bur bltas ma thag don 'brel mi chags pa lta bur snang yang don dngos su de ni don ston tshul gyis 'phur mchongs byas pa yin pa las 'brel med don gzhan ga la yin te/ rgyal dbang bcu gsum pa 'khrungs pa dang rdo ring lha lcam gyis rang la rgyal dbang sprum yod pa'i tshul gyis lus smad la spos dud btang ba gnyis 'phur mchongs byas te bris pa'o/ /bzhi/ tshig sdeb stangs kyi thad/ yid 'gyur mtshon pa'i rig rtsom skad cha de tshig sgrig tshul thad du tshig gcig gis sho lo ka gcig rdzogs pa dang / tshig rkang gcig rdzogs pa/ tshig rkang gnyis rdzogs pa/ gsum rdzogs pa/ sho lo ka gcig dang tshig rkang gcig gnyis/gsum sogs rdzogs par byed pa'i sdeb sbyor byed tshul yod cing / de las tshig gcig gis sho lo ka gcig rdzogs pa ni dper na/ dge 'dun chos 'phel gyis/ ‘dwangs gsal dri ma med pa'i rgya mtsho na/ /ngang ba'i bu mo dal gyis rgyu ba 'dis/ /sprin bral ston gyi nam mkha' trīdīkā pa/ / la/ /nya gang zla ba bgrod pa'i mdzes sdug 'phrog / ces pa dgu pa/ zlos gar rig rtsom gyi skad cha'i rnam gzhag bshad pa/1 ngo bo dang khyad chos/

rig rtsom skad cha'i rigs kyi rnam gzhag rin chen rno 'amigazlos gar rig rtsom gyi skad cha ni zlos gar nang gi mi sna'i skad cha ste mi sna'i kha brda dang chig lab/ glu tshig bcas la go dgos/ kor cis 'khrab gzhung skor bshad pa〉zhes pa'i nang gi 'khrab gzhung ni ches bkol spyod dka' ba'i rig rtsom rnam pa zhig ste/ de dka' ba'i rgyu mtshan gang zhe na/ 'khrab gzhung du zlos gar nang gi mi sna des rang gi skad cha dang bya spyod kyis rang nyid kyi khyad chos mtshon pa'i blang bya yod la/ rtsom mkhan gyi mdzub ston bkol mi chog pa red ces gsung pa ltar 'khrab gzhung nang du mi sna'i skad cha gcig pu las brjod mkhan gyi skad cha med do/ /'o na/ zlos gar rig rtsom nang du mi sna'i skad cha las gzhan yod pa'i skad cha de ci yin zhe na/ de ni 'khrab gzhung du bris pa'i 'khrab gzhung rtsom mkhan gyi mdzub ston skad cha yin pas zlos gar skad cha'i nang du mi 'dus/ ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni 'khrab ston pa dang 'khrab mkhan gyis zlos gar gyi nang don shes par rogs ram byed pa'i gar stegs kyi gsal byed yin pa las snang brnyan btod par mi phan pa red/mdzub ston skad cha der byed las 'di dag yod de/ mi sna dang dus tshod/ sa gnas/ rgyab ljongs bcas la gsal bshad byed pa dang gcig mi sna'i 'gul stangs dang rnam 'gyur la gsal bshad byed thuṭ+wāṃ8 pa dang gnyis/ gar stegs kyi mdzes rtsal dang rol dbyangs/ mi

sa bcad gnyis pa/ gzhung don dngos gzhi/sna 'khrab rar 'jug pa dang ldog par gsal bshad thub pa dang gsum/ 'khrab mgo rtsom pa dang 'khrab mjug sdud pa la gsal bshad byed thub pa dang bzhi'o/ /mdzub ston skad cha de ni 'khrab gzhung nang du zur rogs byed thabs zhig yin mod/ 'on kyang zlos gar rig rtsom nang du med mi rung ba'i cha shas red/ gal te gar stegs gsal bshad dam mdzub ston skad cha med na/ zlos gar byung rim gyi 'phel rgyas dang mi sna'i rang gshis kyi khyad rtags gtso bo ngos 'dzin yang dag byed dka'o/ /der go don gyi dper brjod cig bkod na/ gser 'jig dang dpal skyid ces pa'i 'khrab gzhung gi 'khrab tshan gnyis pa las/ ‘‘sa gnas lha 'bab skyid gzhung grong sde'i mtha' 'khor 'ong kha'i dkyil gyi spang gshongs zhig gi steng / dus tshod ston dus lo tog kun legs par smin zin pa'i nyin mo zhig(gzhas)yul la skyid po gcig dang skyid po gnyis/ /yul la skyid po lha 'bab skyid gzhung na/ /skyid po'i ja chang 'dzoms pa yul der yod/ /dga' ba'i glu dbyangs snyan pa yul der yod//las la brtson pa gcig dang brtson pa gnyis/ /las la brtson pa'i pho gzhon mang po yod/ /dman la mdzes pa gcig dang mdzes pa gnyis/ /dman la mdzes pa lha mo 'dra ba yod/ /dga' skyid kyi dus chen gtong ba'i glu sgra'i nang lha 'bab skyid gzhung 'ong kha'i dkyil gyi sdung

rig rtsom skad cha'i rigs kyi rnam gzhag rin chen rno 'bigagashongs kyi g.yas zur tsam na lteb cog dang 'bol gdan brgyab nas yod pa dang ja chang sogs legs par bsgrigs yod/thag ring du skyed bzang ba'i lo tog rnams sa mtho'i bsil rlung gi khrod na mgo lcog ldem bzhin yod/ sdings cha'i g.yon zur gyi rgyab na sa ngos las phran tsam mtho ba'i spang gshongs zhig yod pa ni bro gar 'khrab sa'i sdings cha zhig yin pa lta bu snang / da lta lha 'bab skyid gzhong rgad po skra lo dung ltar dkar ba zhig dang / /sde dpon bkra shis stong btsan/ a ma tshe gcig lha mo bcas kyis ha cang dga' skyid ldan pa'i ngang mngar zhim chang gi bdud rtsi'i ro bcud longs su spyod bzhin yod cing / sde de'i mi khag gcig ni lag tu phyag dar dang / rnga spub/ dung dkar/ si pa hor/ phye mar/ lo phud sogs 'khyer nas da lta 'ong tshar te khag so so'i gnas skabs kyi sdod gnas su log yong gi yod/ bgres song / (lag tu 'bru'i snye ma 'khyer nas 'bru rdog la grangs ka rgyag bzhin par)e'o/ 'bru rdog brgya dang lnga bcu 'dug ga(rang nyid yid tshim pa'i ngang)phyi snod kyi 'jig rten chags pa'i nang / bcud sems can sna tshogs las kyis skyes/ ma drin can dkar mo'i nas 'bru las/ skyid 'tsho ba'i bza' dung legs par byung / de'i phu bor rin chen rtsam pa dang / de'i nu bor bcud ldan bdud rtsi thogs zer ba ni dngos gnas don snying ldan pa'i skad cha zhig rang red da/80

sa bcad gnyis pa/ gzhung don dngos gzhi/sde dpon lags/ bka' gnang / /nga tsho lha 'bab skyid gzhong zer ba'i steng phyogs lha yul ltar gyi yul phyogs der lo ltar de lta bu'i lo legs byung ba ni nga tsho bod kyi snyan pa'i glu gzhas kyi tshig nang yod pa ltar/ ston zla brgyad pa shar song / /btab pa'i lo tog smin song / /(gzhas gtong ba)dkar mo nas kyi bang mdzod/ /(mnyam gzhas gtong ba)shar phyogs ri las mtho ba/ /hā hā hā/’’zhes pa'i tshig 'di'i nang gi sa gnas dang dus tshod gug rtags nang du yod pa'i skad cha ni mdzub ston skad cha'o/ /zlos gar skad cha la khyad chos gang dag yod ce na/ gsham gsal gyi khyad chos 'di dag yod de/ka shugs drag pa'i 'gul stangs rang bzhin/gar stegs steng gi mi sna ni 'gul ba med par 'dug mi rung ste/gal te 'gul min du bsdad na zlos gar ni khrab bkol nas bzos pa'i 'jim sku ru 'gro ba red/ de bas zlos gar skad cha la shugs drag pa'i 'gul stangs rang bzhin phun sum tshogs pa yod dgos/zlos gar skad cha'i 'gul stangs rang bzhin zhes pa ni ci zhig yin ce na/ de ni zlos gar nang gi mi sna'i skad cha ni mi sna'i gleng mol brjod pa tsam mtshon pa min par da dung skad cha brgyud de mi sna'i 'gul skyod mtshon pa la bya'o/ tshig gzhan bshad na/ mi sna'i gleng mol lam gtam brjod dang bya spyod mtshon pa ni zlos gar skad cha'i 81

rig rtsom rnad cha'i rigs gyi rnam gnag rin chen rno 'thaga'agul stangs rang bzhin zhes pa'o/ /der na/ gser 'jig dang dpal skyid ces pa las/ gser 'jig(mdza' brtse'i ngang)dpal skyid/ dpal skyid(dga' cang dga' pos)cog gser 'jig gser 'jig(the tshom ngang)dpal skyid/ nga nga / dpal skyid/ cog khyed rang khyed rang ga re/gser 'jig dpal skyid/ ngas rang la skad cha tshig kha shas shig shod dgos bsam gyis/ dpal skyid(rang gi snying kha gnon du)cog khyed rang gsungs dang / gser 'jig(blo stobs cher skyed kyis)dpal skyid/ ngas bsam blo thengs mang btang tshar/ phyis 'byung mi tshe 'di'i ring la nga dang mnyam du 'tsho ba bskyal rgyu byung na ngas sdug mnyam myong dang skyid mnyam skyel mtha' gcig tu byed rtsis yod/ dpal skyid/ sdug mnyam myong / skyid mnyam skyes/ gser 'jig de ga red/phyis 'byung nga gnyis skyid la kha'i rtswa la mnyam za dang / sdug sngon mo'i chu la mnyam 'thung byung na bsam gyis/’’zhes pa lta bu mi sna'i kha ༵tā/ ba/rgyud de/ gser 'jig dang dpal skyid kyi 'gul stangs mtshon kha don gyi nyams brjod pa dang yid 'gyur mtshon pa spel mar yod pa/zlos gar rig rtsom ni gtso bor mi sna'i skad cha brgyud de gtam rgyu~X kyi byung rim spel ba yin pas/ don gyi nyams brjod pa yod pa

sa bcad gnyis pa/ gaskung don dngos gzhi/smos ma dgos/ zlos gar rig rtsom gyi don gyi nyams brjod pa de spyir btang du rnam pa gnyis kyi sgo nas spel ba ste/ rnam pa gcig ni don gyi nyams brjod pa'i go rim gyis byung rim gong du 'phel ba mtshon pa red/tshig gzhan zhig nas bshad na/ mi sna dang mi sna'i kha brda byed pa'i go rim ni byung rim gong du 'phel ba'i go rim yin/ de ni 'khrab tshig brgyud de lta mkhan gyi mig lam du tshar du dngar ba'i bya spyod bye brag mngon pa ste/ lta mkhan gyis 'khrab tshig la ro myong byed skabs ni mig gis gar stegs steng nas don dag gong du 'phel ba mngon pa la gtad pa'i skabs yin no/ /don gyi nyams brjod rdzuṭā/ tha/bas tshul de la ched dmigs min pa'i don gyi nyams brjod pa rnam pa cig shos ni/ don gyi nyams brjod pa'i go rim gyis byung rim gyi kyag kyog mtshon pa red/ tshig gzhan zhig nas bshad na/mi sna dang mi sna kha brda byed pa'i dus ni kha 'thab('gal ba)pa'i go rim de gnas skabs mtshams bzhag pa'o/ /de ni 'khrab tshig brgyud de lta mkhan gyi sems la yang skyar sngon chad kyi tshar du dngar ba'i 'tsho ba'i gnas tshul bye brag cig mngon pa dang / yang na gar stegs steng du sngon chad kyi 'tsho ba'i bya dngos bye brag gi sgo nas ston pa red/don gyi nyams brjod pa'i thabs tshul de la ched dmigs rang baspyan

rig rtsom skad cha'i rigs kyi rnam gzhag rin chen rno 'bagagyi don gi nyams brjod pa zer/ zlos gar skad cha ni don gyi nyams brjod pa tsam du ma zad/ dus mtshungs su yid 'gyur mtshon pa'ang yin no/ /zlos gar ni 'khrab mkhan brgyud de gar stegs steng du skad cha bshad pa dang glu blangs te lta mkhan gyi yid g.yo bar byed pa red/'o na/ lta mkhan gyi yid sems g.yo bar byed pa'i rtsa ba'i rgyu rkyen gang zhe na/ 'khrab tshig nang du snum ltar sim pa'i yid 'gyur te/gal te 'khrab tshig tu yid 'gyur mtshon pa'i bro ba med na/ zlos gar la bcud yal bas lta mkhan gyi yid kyi mtsho mo bskyom par byed mi thub bo/ /gzhan yang / 'khrab tshig nang du ched dmigs kyis yid 'gyur mtshon pa'ang yod do/ /ga gsal ba'i nang du zab mo yod pa/klog pa pos zlos gar skad cha ste mi sna'i skad cha la brten nas zlos gar gyi nang don dang mi sna rtogs dgos pas/ zlos gar rig rtsom gyi 'khrab tshig la go dka' ba khyad par du spang dgos/ zlos gar rig rtsom ni 'khrab ston du mkho sprod byed pa yin pas/ zlos gar lta mkhan nang du rig gnas kyi chu tshad mtho dma' bar gsum yod la/'khrab tshig ha cang go dka' ba byed mi rung / phyogs gzhan zhig nas bshad na/ zlos gar gyi 'khrab ston thengs gcig yin pas/ gal te tshisdu gcig lta mkhan gyis go ma thub na/ de gzhan pa go sla ba min

sa bcad gnyis pa/ gzhung don dngos gzhi/pas 'khrab tshig go sla ba byed dgos/yin na'ang / mis go thub pa byed rgyu ni gnad don gyi phyogs gcig ste ches sla ba'i blang bya red/ gal te mis bltas ma thag/ tshang ma ma go na skad cha de chu 'khyag 'thung ba bzhin bro med ro med bzhin 'gyur bas mi legs so/ /phul du byung ba'i 'khrab tshig ni mi rnams kyis bltas ma thag tshig go sla yang / don la ro bcud ldan pa'i bu ram bzhin myangs byin myangs kyin bro ba khyad par ba yod snang skyed/de la gsal ba'i nang du zab mo yod pa bya'o/ /'khrab tshig la bro ba dang ldan par bya ba la gsham gsal don gnyis bsgrub dgos/dang po/ 'khrab tshig la bsam blo gtong sa yod dgos pa/bshad 'dod pa tshang ma bshad tshar pa dang 'bri 'dod pa tshang ma bris tshar ba mi byed par/ mang tshogs kyi rnam rtog gi nus par yid ches bya dgos/ gnyis pa/ 'khrab tshig la shugs bstan yod dgos pa/ci zhig la 'khrab tshig shugs bstan zhe na/ o'u dbyangs yus chan gyisaṭ+wāṃ'akhrab mkhan gyis nges par du 'khrab tshig legs par 'don dgos〉zhes pa'i nang du 'khrab tshig shugs bstan pa ni 'khrab tshig la gting zab pa'i don zhig ldan pa ste/ tha snyad kyi ngo bo dang /'khrab tshig gis mtshon pa'i mi sna'i nang sems kyi 'gul skyod yin zhes pa ltar ro/ gal te rtsom mkhan gyis 'khrab tshig brgyud de yang 85

rig rtsom skad cha'i rigs kyi rnam gnag rin chen rno 'thagadag pa'i sgo nas mi sna'i nang sems kyi 'gul skyod go rim mtshon par byed thub na/ 'khrab tshig de la 'khrab tshig shugs bstan yod do/ /zlos gar skad cha la gsal ba dang zab mo dgos pa'i blang bya yod pas/ de dag 'gal ba ma yin nam zhe na/ min te/ gsal bas zab pa mi 'phud la/ de las ldog ste/ zab pas kyang gsal ba phyir mi 'phud pa red/ skad cha kha gsal zhing go sla la/ don zab mo zhig ldan pa bya rgyu de ni las sla mo red de/ gsal ba gzhir byas kyi steng du zab mo spel ba dang / zab mo nang du gsal ba mngon par byas na/ zab mo dang gsal ba gnyis 'gal zla gcig 'du bya dgos pa'o/ /2 zlos gar rig rtsom skad cha'i las 'gan/zlos gar rig rtsom dang sgrung rtsom gnyis bsdur nas bshad na/de gnyi gas skad cha la brten nas snang brnyan btod pa'i cha nas gcig na'ang / sgrung rtsom gyis snang brnyan btod pa'i tshe/ mi sna'i skad cha ma gtogs da dung rjod pa po'i skad cha mang po bkol chog pa dang / zlos gar rig rtsom gyis mi sna'i skad cha kho nar brten nas snang brnyan btod par bya dgos/ de'i stabs kyis zlos gar skad cha'i las 'gan ha cang lci ba red/ zlos gar skad cha'i las 'gan bsdus na gnyis yod de/dang po/ zlos gar skad chas byung rim gong du 'phel bar skul 'ded byed dgos pa/86

sa bcad gnyis pa/ gzhuja don dngos gzhi/gar stegs steng gi byung rim gong du 'phel ba'i rgyu rkyen gnyis yod de gcig ni mi sna'i lus kyi 'gul stangs dang / cig shos ni mi sna'i skad cha'o/ /mi sna'i skad cha brgyud de byung rim 'phel bar skul 'ded byed pa zhes pa'i don ni/ mi sna'i skad chas zlos gar nang gi 'gal ba kha 'thab kyi mgo rtsom pa dang byung bar byed las hur thag gis thon par byed pa ste/ 'gal ba kha 'thab byung bar bcug pa dang / 'gal zlo sdo ༵zlo/ba/ 'phel bar byed pa/ 'gal ba kha 'thab thag gcod par gnyis pa/ mi sna'i rang gshis mtshon dgos pa/zlos gar skad cha ni zlos gar nang gi mi sna'i skad cha gcig pu yin pas/ zlos gar nang gi mi sna'i rang gshis gsar sgrun byed pa ni gtso bor mi sna'i skad char brten dgos/ des na/ phul du byung ba'i zlos gar skad cha ni rang gshis can yin la/ der blang bya gtso bo gnyis yod de/ gcig ni zlos gar nang gi mi sna'i skad cha nges par du mi sna'i byung rabs dang mthun dgos la/ cig shos ni zlos gar nang gi mi sna'i skad cha de mi sna'i rang gshis kyi khyad rtags 'bur du thon par byed dgos pa'o/ /zhi 3 zlos gar rig rtsom skad cha'i rnam pa'i sna tshogs rang ba na/ 87

rig rtsom skad cha'i rigs kyi rnam gzhag rin ra rno 'thagazlos gar rig rtsom skad cha la mtshon stangs phun sum tshogs pa yod de/ kha brda ni zlos gar rig rtsom skad cha'i mtshon stangs gtso bo zhig yin zhing / gtam brjod zlos gar la dgos gal shin tu che la/zlos gar gyi rnam pa gzhan gyi nang du'ang med du mi rung ngo / /chig lab dang zur bshad ni zlos gar rig rtsom skad cha'i nang du rgyun du mthong ba'i mtshon stangs shig ste/ de dag ni zlos gar nang gi mi snas byung rim 'phel ba'i go rim du rang gis rang la bshad pa'o//glu tshig ni mi snas glu blangs pa'i skad cha ste/ zlos gar rig rtsom skad cha'i mtshon stangs shig red/gzhan yang / tshig sbyor gyi rnam pa'i cha nas phye na/ bcad lhug spel ma gsum yod do/ /mjug bsdu ba'isnyegatam/bod kyi rig rtsom skad cha'i rigs kyi rnam sazhag mdo tsam brjod pa zhes pa 'di ni bdag gis spyi lo1989lo'i zla3par nub byang mi rigs slob grwa chen mor slob gnyer byed pa'i skabs su hra'o hri'i thob thang gi ched rtsom du bris pa yin/ spyir na ched rtsom 'di ni bod kyi rig rtsom don dngos la gzhir bcas pa dang deng dus 'dzam 88

sa bcad gnyis pa/ gzhung don dngos gzhi/gling du dar che ba'i rig rtsom gzhung lugs gsar ba'i bcud len khul byas te/ bod kyi rig rtsom skad cha la yul skad dang phal skad dang yig skad dang tshigs bcad dang tshig lhug dang spel ma dang /don gyi nyams brjod pa'i rig rtsom skad cha dang yid 'gyur mtshon pa'i rig rtsom skad cha dang zlos gar rig rtsom skad cha bcas rigs dgur phye nas rang gi lta tshul gsar ba 'don khul byas kyang / gcig tu na rang gis rig rtsom gzhung lugs mang po sbyangs goms med pa dang / gnyis su na dgos nges kyi dpyad gzhi'i yig rigs mtha' dag lag tu ma chud pa dang / gsum du na bzo bcos kyi khom long ma byung ba bcas kyi dbang gis rtsom 'dir nor ba dang 'khrul ba'i cha yod nges pas gzur gnas kyi blo gros dang ldan pa rnams kyis dgongs 'char lhug stsol gnang rgyu mkhyen mkhyen zhu/ /89

sa bcad dang po/ rtsom 'jug gi go rim dang rtsa ba'i nus pa/sa bcad dang po/ rtsom 'jug gi go rim dang rtsa ba'i nus pa/don tshan dang po/ rtsom gyi rtsa ba'i grub cha gtso bo/dang po/ rtsom gyi go don/rtsom zhes pa la sgra yangs dog gi 'jug tshul gnyis yod de/ sgra yangs 'jug gi dbang du byas na gtan chags su grub pa'i ngag gi brjod tshul la go zhing / der gnas stangs kyi sgo nas phye na/ skyes bu'i ngag gi rjod byed kyi rnam par gnas pa dang / dpe thog yi ge'i gzugs su gnas pa ste gnyis yod la/ snga ma ni dper na dmangs khrod kyi gtam rgyud dang sgrung / glu gzhas dang khed lta bu ste/ de la sgra dang ldan te rna ba'i spyod yul yin zhing / phyi ma'i mtshan gzhi ni dpe thog gi sgrung rtsom dang rtogs brjod/ dpyad rtsom lta bu dang / der sgra mi ldan te mig gi spyod yul las rna ba'i spyod yul min pa red/ sgra dog 'jug gi dbang du byas na gtan chags su grub pa'i yig thog ngag gi brjod tshul la go dgos pa ste/ de dang rtsom 'jug ces pa'i rtsom dang don gcig go93

rtsom 'jug gi bshad khrid gnad chings gzur gnas 'jug ngogs/gnyis pa/ rtsom gyi rtsa ba'i grub cha gtso bo/rtsom zhig gi nang don gyi grub cha ni rgyu cha dang dgongs don gtso bo dang gnas lugs bcas yin la/ zhen chags dang gnas lugs ni rtsom gyi dgongs don gtso bo dang rgyu cha la 'o chu 'dres pa bzhin du snang bas/ dgongs don gtso bo dang rgyu cha brgyud de zhen chags mtshon par bya dgos/ de'i gnad kyis dgongs don gtso bo dang rgyu cha ni rtsom gyi nang don gyi grub cha gtso bo gnyis red/tshig gis dum bcad dang / dum bcad kyis rim pa dang / rim pas rtsom grub po/ rtsom gyi kha byang ni rtsom gyi grub cha yin la/ rtsom mgo 'dzugs tshul gyi nang don gtso bo red/ nang don dang rtsom lus mi 'dra bar mtshon stangs mi 'dra ba bkol dgos la/ rtsom gyi sgrig tshul gyi rnam pa'ang mi 'dra/ de bas/ sgrig tshul dang mtshon stangs ni rtsom gyi rnam pa'i grub cha gtso bo gnyis red/tshig ni nges can gyi brda sprod lugs gzhir bzung ste ming du ma 'dus pa las grub cing / brjod pa ni bya dngos dang chags zhen gnas lugs mtshon pa'i 'brel sbyor byed pa'i spyin lta bu yin la/rtsom gyi rnam pa'i grub cha zhig kyang red/ skad cha la rnam pa mi 'dra ba yod de/ rtsom gyi rnam pa dang rtsom lus mi 'dra ba la nges par du skad cha'i rnam pa mi 'dra ba spel te mtshon par bya dgos/94

sa bcad dang po/ rtsom 'jug gi go rim dang rtsa ba'i nus pa/gong smos mdor bsdus na/ rtsom ni rgyu cha dang dgongs don gtso bo dang / sgrig tshul dang skad cha dang mtshon stangs te rtsa ba'i grub cha lnga yis grub pa red/don tshan gnyis pa/ rtsom 'jug gi go rim/dang po/ rtsom 'jug bya spyod kyi khrad chos/rtsom 'jug ni bsam pa'i thon rdzas gsar skrun byed pa'i ngal rtsol zhig yin zhing / de'i yul can gyi ngal rtsol byed stangs dang spyir btang gi dngos rdzas thon rdzas byed stangs gnyis mi 'dra ba red/rtsom bzo ba'i go rim nang du byung ba dang rtsom mkhan gyi phyi dang nang zhes pa tshad 5gi mthon pos zung 'brel dang gcig gyur gyi ngal rtsol rnyog 'dzing der rtsom 'jug gi bya spyod zer/ 'o na/ rtsom 'jug bya spyod kyi khyad chos gang yin zhe na/ yul can gyis rtsom bzo ba'i go rim steng nas bltas na/ rtsom 'jug bya spyod kyi thun min byed stangs ni rim gsum 'phur mchong zhes zhwa red/thog mar 'dod yon lnga ste/ gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya bcas tshor dbang lnga brgyud de klad par shar te sngar gyi shes yon dang rigs lam/ yid 'gyur bcas la 'dres te tshor ba'i shes rtosdus

rtsom 'jug gi bshad khrid gnad chings gzur gnas 'jug ngogs/byung / de nas tshor shes kyi rgyu cha je mang du song ste rjes dpag gi shes rtogs byung ngo / /phyi yul gyi dngos po de rtsom mkhan gyi nang sems kyi shes par 'phel pa'i go rim der tshor shes kyi 'phur mchong zer te/de ni rtsom 'jug bya spyod gyi dus rim dang po red/de'i 'phror/ rtsom 'jug gi bya spyod kyi nang sgrum 'phur mchodo zer ba yin te/ rtsom pa'i kun slong skyes pa na rtsom 'jug yul can gyi shes hogs de kun slong gis bsgyur ba'i 'og tu phyogs gcig nas dngos gzugs sna mang de klad par 'char bar bcug pa dang /phyogs gcig nas klad pa'i skye lugs la bsten nas sgrig tshul gyi rnam pa 'tshogs pa ma zad/ yul can klad chen gyi skye lugs te dran 'dzin 'brel rtog rnam rtog dbye zhib/ rigs 'ded/ phye 'dzum 'brel sbyor legs kyi nus par brten nas rtsom pa'i rgyu cha bsags pa dang snang brnyan gsar pa bskrun te/ 'du shes gsar ba da nga bsam pa gsar pa byung ste/ rtsom yig gi mngal chags pa'o/ /rtsom 'jug yul can gyi klad chen du byung ba dang gsar skrun byas pa'i cha tshang pa'i sems kyi thon rdzas te rtsom yig gi mngal chags pa'i go rim der nang sbrum 'phur mchong zer/de ni rtsom 'junabya spyod kyi srog shing gi cha yin/ /gsum pa ni rtsom 'jug bya spyod phyir mngon 'phur mcho ra te/de ni rtsom 'dug bya spyod mtha' ma'i dus rim red/ dus rim der rtsom 'jug yul can gyis 'bri ba'i mtshon rtsal la brten nas/ skad 96

sa bcad dang po/ rtsom wīg gi go rim dang rtsa ba'i nus pa/yig steng du klad par mngal chags pa'i rtsom yig de phyi'i dngos po'i gzugs su bsgyur ba'o/ /gnyis pa/ rtsom 'jug gi dus rim dang lha tshigs/cha tshang ba'i rtsom 'jug ma lag gi bzo skrun la dus rim rang bzhin dang go rim go rim rang bzhin yod de/ rtsom zhig bzo ba'am rig rtsom brtsams chos zhig gsar rtsom byed pa'i go rim ni phal cher dus rim gsum du phye chog ste/ dang po ni 'tshol sdud kyi dus rim yin zhing / 'tshol sdud ni tshor dbang bkol nas dngos yod 'tsho ba dang dpe deb kyi dpyad gzhi nang nas rtsom 'jug gi sa bon 'dzin pa dang 'tshol sdud byas pa'i sa bon de rtsom 'jug gi rgyu char bsgyur ba ste/ de ni rtsom bzo ba'i dus rim dang po yin zhing / de'i las 'gan gtso bo ni rgyu cha'i yong khungs thag gcod pa dang / rtsom la 'jug pa'i rmang gzhi legs par bskrun pa red/ rtsom 'jug gi kun slong ni dus rim de'i snga phyir skyes pa dang / rdzor shes kyi 'phur mchongs kyang dus rim der mngon par byas pa yin no/ /gnyis pa ni bsam bkod kyi dus rim yin zhing / dus rim der rtsom mkhan gyis blo gros rtsal dang nus rtsal sna tshogs bkod sgrig byas te klad chen nang du 'tshol sdud byas pa'i rgyu cha 'dor len dang las snon/ gsar skrun bcas byas nas rtsom gyi dgongaṭa/ don gtso bo 97

rtsom 'jug gi bshad khrid gnad chings gzur gnas 'jug ngogs/chags pa dang rtsom gyi sgrig tshul bsam bkod 'then pas nang sbrum gyi dus rim byung ba red/gsum pa ni mtshon brjod kyi dus rim yin zhing / mtshon brjod la ston pa dang / mtshon pa'ang zer ro/ de ni rtsom mkhan gyis skad yig gi steng nas mtshon stangs dang mtshon thabs 'os mtshams 'dems te klad par bsam bkod byas pa'i 'bras bu bye brag gis bkod brjod dang / klad chen phyi las rang tshugs su grub pa'i yig thog gi skad cha'i rnam par bsgyur ba red/rtsom 'jug gi bzo rim steng nas dbye na/ rtsom gyi bzo sgrun ni lhu tshigs lnga la phye chog pa ste/ brjod don bzhengs pa dang rgyu cha 'dems pa dang rtsom khog bsgrig pa dang rtsom gdan 'ding ba dang skyorna sel ba bcas yin la/ brjod don bzhengs pa ni bsam bkod kyi lhu lag gtso bo dang / rgyu cha 'dems pa dang rtsom khog bsgrig pa'ang gtso chen bsam bkod nang du byed pa yin/ rtsom gdan 'ding ba ni mtshon brjod dus rim gyi bzo rim dang po dang skyon sel ba ni rtsom 'jug gi ches mtha' ma'i lhu tshigs yin no/rim /sna/ rim gsum dang lhu tshigs lnga ni rtsom 'jug gi rtsa ba'i go

sa bcad dang po/ rtsom 'jug gi go rim dang rtsa ba'i nus pa/don tshan gsum pa/ rtsom 'jug gi rtsa ba'i nus pa/dang po/ rtsom 'jug gi nus pa'i go don/rtsom 'jug slob tshan ni rmang gzhi'i slob tshan zhig yin zhing /de la lag len gyi rang bzhin shin tu che ba red/ rtsom 'jug gi nus pa skyed sring dang je mthor gtong ba ni rtsom 'jug slob tshan gyi gzhi rtsa'i las 'gan dang dmigs yul yin te/ slob khrid nang don gyi sgrig srol la jus 'god dang sbyong brdar gyi nang don bkod sgrig byed pa mtha' dag slob ma'i rtsom 'jug gi nus pa je mthor gtong ba'i dmigs tshad gtso bor byed dgos pa red/ 'o na/ ci zhig la rtsom 'jug gi nus pa zer zhe na/ nus pa der phyogs gnyis kyi nang don ldan pa ste/ gcig ni mi rnams kyis 'gul skyod nges can sgrub pa'i bye brag gi byed stangs dang / cig shos ni 'gul skyod nges can bde blag tu 'grub par dgos nges kyi sems khams khyad chos so/ /rtsom bzo ba'i 'gul skyod khyad par can de'i steng nas bshad na/ rtsom 'jug gi nus pa ni rtsom bzo ba'i go rim nang du rtsom mkhan gyis blo gros kyi rtsal dang rtsom 'jug thabs rtsal sna 'dzoms bkol spyod byas pa'i yon tan la go dgos/pyi9

rtsom 'jug gi bshad khrid gnad chings gzur gnas 'jug ngogs/gnyis pa/ rtsom 'jug gi rtsa ba'i nus pa/rtsom 'jug gis nus pa ni 'phred dkyus bsnol ba'i yul can rnam pa'i sgrig tshul zhig ste/ der gtogs pa shin tu mang yang ches rtsa ba'i nus pa ni lta rtog nus pa dang brtag dpyad kyi nus pa dang myong tshor gyi nus pa dang klog 'don gyi nus pa dang dbye zhib rigs 'ded kyi nus pa dang rnam rtog 'brel rtog gi nus pa dang phye 'dzum 'brel sbyor gyi nus pa dang ngag sbyor dbang sgyur ba'i nus pa dang thabs 'phrul bkol ba'i nus pa dang skyon sel nyams btod pa'i nus pa dang yig ngos bkod sgrig gi nus pa bcas yin/rtsom bzo ba'i go rim nang du gong smos rtsa ba'i nus pa bcu gcig ni phan tshun 'brel ba dang phan tshun shan shugs thebs pa/phan tshun tshod 'dzin byed pa dang phan tshun kha bral mi thub pa red/rtsom 'jug gi lhu tshigs gang du gnad don byung ba dang yang na nus pa zhig chad na de dag gis rtsom 'jug gi 'gul skyod bde blag tu byed par bkag 'gog dang rtsom gyi spus tshad la gnod byed nges/de'i gnad kyis rtsom 'jug gi rtsa ba'i nus pa bcu gcig je mthor gtong ba gnad du che'o/ /100

sa bcad dang po/ rtsom 'jug gi go rim dang rtsa ba'i nus pa/sa bcad gnyis pa/ 'tshol sdud kyi dus rim/rtsom 'jug gi go rim ni 'tshol sdud dang bsam bkod dang mtshon brjod de dus rim gsum du phye ba red/ dbye tshul de ni 'gyur ba med pa dang ltos pa med pa min zhing dus rim gsum po gtan nas kha bral ba med/ 'on kyang dus rim ltos bcas re'i steng du dgos nges kyi thag gcod rgyu'i gnad don gal chen re snang /rgyu cha 'tshol sdud ni rtsom 'jug gi dus rim dang po'i nang thog mar bsgrub pa'i las don yin la/ rgyu cha 'bor chen 'tshol sdud bya bar/ nges par du rang gi lta rtog gi nus pa daṭ+wāṃ brtag dpyakā kyi sdodṛ trī /mthor jirte rdo je sdi //sa pa dang klog 'don d+ngha nus pa skyed nga 101

rtsom 'jug gi bshad khrid gnad chings gzur gnas 'jug ngogs/don tshan dang po/ rgyu cha dang de'i byed las/dang po/ byu cha'i go don/rgyu cha ni rtsom la 'jug par 'tshol sdud dang brtsams chos su spel ba'i don dngos kyi snang tshul dang gzhung lugs kyi rten gzhi yin zhing / de yang dper na/ mi sna dang don dag gzhi grangs dang dper bkod/ yul ljongs dang gnas lugs sogs red/rtsom nang du spel ba'i rgyu cha ni rtsom gyi nang don gyi rtsa ba'i grub cha gtso bo zhig dang / sgrig tshul sgrig byed kyi dngos po'i lhu lag yin la/ dgongs don gtso bo mtshon pa dang gsal bshad byed par med mi rung ba'i khungs skyes sa'ang red/ de la la las rtsom gzhi yang zer gyin 'dug rtsom la 'jug par 'tshol sdud byas pa'i rgyu cha ni rtsom mkhan gyis dngos yod 'tsho ba'i nang nas 'tshol sdud byas te/ dag sgrig dang las snon ma brgyud pa la bstan zhing / der gdod ma'i rgyu cha dang sa bon zhes 'bod pa snang ste/ dper na rnam thar gyi sa bon zhes grags pa lta bu'o/ / rdzo102

sa bcad dang po/ rtsom 'jug gi go rim dang rtsa ba'i nus pa/gnyis pa/ rgyu cha'i dbye ba/rmi cha la rigs dbye tshul ni du ma zhig mchis kyang rtsom la 'jug pa'i gnad ka'i steng nas gsham gyi rigs 'gar phye chog go/(dang po) don dngos rgyu cha dang gzhung lugs rgyu cha/don dngos rgyu cha ni lo rgyus thog tu byung ba dang yang na da skabs dngos su snang ba'i bya dngos yin la/ der chags zhen dang rtog bzo/ rnam rtog dang sgro bkur ci yang mi 'dres pa red/ don dngos ni tshan rig 'gul skyod mtha' dag gi rten gzhi ches gal che ba yin pas/ 'gro ba mis rtsom 'jug 'gul skyod byed par thog mar dgos nges kyi tshe srog gi gzhi rgyu lta bu yin zhing / dngos bkol rtsom dang rig gzhung dpyad rtsom/ tshan rig brtsams chos mtha' dag ni don dngos rgyu cha gzhir bzung ste rtsom 'bri byas pa red/ rgyu cha 'tshol sdud byed na thog mar don dngos rgyu cha nas mgo rtsom dgos so/ /gzhung lugs rgyu cha ni mi rnams kyis don dngos snang tshul de spyi mtshan gyis rtogs te byung ba'i rjes dpag rgyud tshang ba'i shes rtogs red/ de ni dbye zhib dang phyogs bsdus/ rgyud tshang bsam daphyod byas te byung ba'i thon dngos yin pa ste/ phyi yul gyi chos nyid mtha' dag mi'i bsam pa'i 'du shes su phyogs bsdus kyis tshur snang ba dang /der tshan rig rang bzhin gyi khyad chos ldan pa red/ de spyir btang du 103

rtsom 'jug gi bshad khrid gnad chings gzur gnas 'jug ngogs/phyogs gsum du 'dus pa ste/ (1)gzhung lugs kyi ma lag rgyud tshang ba dang rig gzhung bsam blo cha tshang ba/ (2)sil bu dang bye brag gi tshan rig gnas lugs dang nges srol dang nges lugs dang maskyon nyid dang rjod gzhi dang rtsa don sogs dang / (3)spyi tshogs spyi lugs te spyi tshogs rgyud tshang zhig gi nang du spyi tshogs khongs mi thun mong gis khas len pa'i kun spyod 'du shes dang mi chos 'du shes/ rin thang 'du shes sogs phyogs kyi tshad gzhi dang rtsa don mtha' dag bcas so/ /spyi tshogs mtho rim du ji ltar 'phel na gzhung lugs kyi rgyu cha de ltar phun sum tshogs par 'gro ba red/(gnyis pa) dga' snang rgyu cha dang dngos med rgyu cha/rgyu cha'i yid brtan med pa'i rang bzhin dang 'gyur ba'i rang bzhin gyi phyogs nas bltas na/ dga' snang rgyu cha dang dngos med rgyu cha gnyis snang ste/ yid brtan med pa ni dga' snang rgyu cha'i khyad chos gtso bo dang 'gyur ba'i rang bzhin ni dngos med rgyu cha'i khyad chos gtso bo red/ dga' snang rgyu cha'i nang du bden pa dang ngag rgyun 'chug ste 'gyur ba byung ba yod la/ bden dzun spel ma dang don dngos kyi 'dzin gzhi med pa'ang yod do/ de'i nang don gyi phyogs nas bltas na/ nges can gyi tshan rig gnas lugs bstan pa dang mi'i yul can gyi re 'dun mtshon pa snang zhing / mi rnams kyi mdzes 'dzin dga' snang mtshon pa'ang yod pa red/ der lha sgrung dang 104

sa bcad dang po/ rtsom 'jug gi go rim dang rtsa ba'i nus pa/legs bshad/ mtshar gtam dang dgod gtam sogs 'dus so/ /dngos med rgyu cha zer ba ni rig rtsom brtsams chos nang du gsar rtsom brgyud de yul can gcig gyur dang mngon gyur dang zhen chags can du 'gyur ba byung ste tha dad du gyur ba'i rgyu cha red/dngos med rgyu cha la gnas tshul gtso bo gsum yod/ (1)tshab mtshon can dang phyogs bsdus can/ rig rtsom gyis dngos yod 'tsho ba tshab mtshon phyogs bsdus kyis mtshon par byed pas/ phyogs bsdus dang las snon brgyud pa'i rig rtsom snang brnyan ni 'tsho ba'i ma rnam dang mi 'dra ste/ 'tsho ba'i ma rnam zhig nas mgo brtsams pa dang rgya bskyed pa dang gting je zab tu btang bas/ sgyu rtsal snang brtan tshab mtshon ldan par gyur ba dang yang na sna tshogs blangs te gcig tu bsdus pa dang spungs pa'i mi snar gyur pa ste/ mdor na de ni 'tsho ba ngo ma'i nang gi mi dang don dag min pa red/(2)zhen chags can dang mdzes sdug can/ phyi yul bya dngos ni rig rtsom mkhas pa'i klad par shar ba na gsar rtsom yul can gyi sems pas tshor ba sna tshogs myangs par gyur zhing / yul ljongs dang snang brnyan dang dngos gzugs mtha' dag ni gal te mdzes 'dzin 'du shes kyis bltas na rang byung gi mir gyur dang mir gyur rang byung zhes pa mngon par 'byung ba red/ (3)rnam rtog can dang rtog bzo can/ rig rtsom gsar rtsom nang du rtsom pa bas rang gi klad par snang ba'i bya dngos 105

rtsom 'jug gi bshad khrid gnad mings gzur gnas 'jug ngogs/kyi phyi tshul ni yang bskyar sgrig pa dang rtog bzo byas te/ dngos su med pa'i snang brnyan dang don rkyen dang yul khams gsar sgrun bgyis pa red/ rtog bzo de ni mi'i klad par khyad par du yod pa'i rnam rtog gi yon tan gyis gsar du bsgrun pa'i 'bras bu yin no/ /ljonga~X rā/ spyam/ pa) gtso gnad rgyu cha dang gshib bsdur rgyu cha dang rgyab rtsom 'jug bya yul bar gyi gtso phal 'brel ba'i steng nas gtso gnad rgyu cha dang gshib bsdur rgyu cha dang rgyab ljongs rgyu cha ste rigs gsum la phye rung ngo / gtso gnad rgyu cha ni rtsom 'jug bya yul gtso bo yin zhing / gshib bsdur rgyu cha dang rgyab sngongs rgyu cha ni rtsom 'jug bya yul gtso ngo'i zur lta'i ma lag phyogs kyi rgyu cha red/ bgro gleng rtsom nang gi skrub byed kyi rgyu cha dang gsal bshad rtsom gyi gsal bshad bya yul gyi ngo bo dang grub rkyen/ byed las la bkol ba'i rgyu cha lta bu'o/ gshib bsdur rgyu cha ni gtso gnad rgyu cha dang bsdur ba dang shan sbyar byas pa'i bya dngos dang don rkyen dang gzhi grangs sogs so/ /der gnas tshul rigs gsum ldan pa ste/ (1)bsdur ba'i rgyu cha/ (2)rigs bsgre dang dpe 'jog gi rgyu cha/ (3)gal 'dzugs rgyu cha bcas red/rgyab ljongs rgyu cha ni spyir gtso gnad rgyu cha dang 'brel ba snang yang gtso gnad rgyu cha'i khongs su mi gtogs pa red/ de'i nang du lo 106

sa bcad dang po/ rtsom 'jug gi go rim dang rtsa ba'i nus pa/rgyus rgyab ljongs phyogs kyi rgyu cha dang dngos yod rgyab ljongs phyogs kyi rgyu cha yod la/ bsam blo'i rgyab ljongs phyogs kyi rgyu cha dang sa khongs rgyab ljongs phyogs kyi rgyu cha'ang snang ngo /gsum pa/ byu cha'i byed las/rtsom rgyag pa'i go rim yongs nas bltas na/ rgyu cha'i byed las ni gsham gyi 'brel ba cha gsum du 'dus pa ste/gtso ༵/ rgyu cha dang yul can ngos 'dzin/ 2 rgyu cha dang dgongs don 3 rgyu cha dang rtsom gyi rngam pa bcas so/don tshan gnyis pa/ 'tshol sdud kyi thabs lam dang byed thabs/dang po/ lta rtog/lta rtog ni yul can 'du shes kyis dbang sgyur ba'i 'og tshor dbang gis phyi yul cha 'phrin bsdu len byas pa'i 'gul skyod dang /'tsho bar shes rtogs dang rgyu cha gsog 'jog byed pa'i ches rtsa ba dang thog ma'i bya spyod red/ 'o na/ lta rtog ji ltar bya dgos zhe na/107

rtsom 'jug gi bshad khrid gnad chings gzur gnas 'jug ngogs/(dang po)lta rtog gi gnad ka legs par 'dems nas lta rtog kyi rim pa gtan 'khel yag po bya dgos/bya dngos la lta rtog byed dus drang phyogs dang ldog phyogs nas lta rtog bya dgos la/ 'gul rnam dang 'jags rnam gyi steng nas kyang lta rtog bya dgos pa ste/ lta rtog gi gnad ka ma gcig na shes pa byung ba mi 'dra bas/ rtsom 'jug la bsdu len byas pa'i rgyu cha la'ang thun min gyi khyad chos yod do/ spyir lta rtog gi gom rim ni spyi khog—cha shas—spyi khog bcas yin/dgo~X/gnyis pa)lta rtog bya yul gyi khyad chos 'dzin par do snang bya (gsum pa)dbang lnga mnyam bkol la do snang bya dgos/dgo~X bzhi ba)lta rtog gi mthong rgya je cher gtong bar do snang bya (lnga ba)lta rtog gi nyin tho 'bri ba rgyun 'khyodas bya dgos/gnyis pa/ myong tshor/myong tshor ni phyi yul gyi shugs rkyen thebs te byung ba'i sems kyi nyams myong zhig ste/ de ni lta rtog je zab tu song nas phyi rim bag chags de sems khong gi tshor shes su gyur pa'o//(dang po) myong tshor la yid 'dzin dang bsam gzhig byed par 108

go sabacadadang po/ rtsom 'jug gi go rim dang rtsa ba'i nus pa/mkhas( r+shabye~X/ pa) myong tshor gyi tshor rno rang bzhin dang thun min gyi khyad chos rang bzhin sbyong brdar bya dgos/(gsum pa) chags tshor rgyu rkyen dang rjes dpag rgyu rkyen gyi shugs je drag tu gtong dgos/gsum pa/ brtag dpyad/brtag dpyad ni dmigs yul dang bya yul yod pa'i sgo nas rgyu cha 'tshol sdud byed pa'i phan 'bras ldan pa'i byed thabs red/(1)brtag dpyad bya na thog mar bya yul legs par 'dems pa dang bsam pa'i gra sgrig yag po bya dgos/(2)bya dngos kyi rang bzhin 'dzin dgos/(3)byed stangs dang byed thabs 'os 'tsham bkol dgos/brtag dpyad byed stangs la yongs khyab brtag dpyad dang tshab mtshon brtag dpyad dang 'dra dpe brtag dpyad bcas yod/ byed thabs la brtag dpyad tshogs 'du dang 'dri shog brtag dpyad dang yul dngos la brtag dpyad byed pa sogs snang /(4)zin bris legs par 'debs dgos/109

bzhi ba/ klog 'don/klog 'don ni rgyu cha thob par byed pa'i thabs lam gal chen zhig ste/ mi zhig gi tshe gang bo'i nang du shes yon mang shos ni klog 'don brgyud de bsags pa red/ klog 'don gyi myur tshad dang las /tā bye sdo/ṭ+wāṃ/ gtong ched nges par du klog 'don byed thabs la do (dang po) bam klog dang zhib klog zung 'brel bya dgos/(gnyis pa)'dems klog gi nus pa dang phan ldan cha 'phrin 'dor len gyi nus pa je mthor gtong dgos/(gsum pa) klog 'don zin bris dang dpyad mchan legs par 'debs dgos/mdor na/ lta rtog dang myong tshor dang brtag dpyad dang klog 'don ni rgyu cha thob byed kyi thabs lam dang byed thabs red/110

sa bcad dang bo/ rtsom 'jug gi go rim dang rtsa ba'i nus pa/don tshan gsum pa/ rgyu cha'i dbye 'byed gdam gses bkol ྅snyed/dang po/ rgyu cha dbye 'byed byed thabs/rgyu cha dbye 'byed ji ltar bya dgos zhe na/dgo~X/dang po) rang mtshan la dbye zhib dang rigs gtan 'khel bya (gnyis pa) bden rdzun dbye 'byed dang legs nyes gsal por 'byed dgos/dgo~X/gsum pa) rin thang la zhib 'jug byas te don snying btsal gnyis pa/ rgyu cha 'dems pa'i rtsa don/dgos(/dang po)dgongs don gtso bo la dmigs nas rgyu cha 'dems dgo~X/gnyis pa)bden pa dang yid brtan pher ba'i rgyu cha 'dems (gsum pa)tshab mtshon rgyu cha 'dems dgos/111

rtsom 'jug gi bshad khrid gnad chings gzur gnas 'jug ngogs/(bzhi ba)gsar pa dang gson nyams can 'dems dgos/gsum pa/ rgyu cha bamakha spyod kyi blang bya/(dang po) rgyu cha dang lta ba'i gtan tshigs gcig gyur bya dgos/(gnyis pa)dpe mtshon dang bden sgrub dang sgrub byed kyi khyad par la do snang bya dgos/bar sdo kāgām bya pa sdogos/bye brag dang gson nyams ldan pa'i rgyu cha bkol (bzhi ba) rtsom mkhan thun min gyi myong tshor dang rtsom 'jug rang gshis kyi rgyu cha bkol bar do snang bya dgos pa/112

sa bcad gsum pa/ bsam bkod kyi dus rim/sa bcad gsum pa/ bsam bkod kyi dus rim/don tshan dang po/ bsam bkod kyi byed las dang blang bya/dang po/ bsam bkod kyi go don/bsam bkod ni rtsom 'jug yul can gyis rgyu cha khong du chud pa'i rmang gzhi steng du rtsom dang brtsams chos skyed sring byed pa'i dmigs yul can gyi gsar skrun rang bzhin gyi bsam gzhig 'gul skyod dang / rtsom la spyi khog steng nas jus 'god byed pa yin zhing /der dgongs don gtso bo bsam gzhig dang rgyu cha 'dor len dang sgrig tshul gyi khungs sne dang nang don la 'tshams pa'i mtshon byed rnam pa bkod sgrig dang jus 'god byed pa sogs 'dus so/ /gnyis pa/ bsam bkod kyi byed las/thab ༵/dang po) 'tshol sdud dang mtshon brjod bar la zam pa 'phen ༄ (gnyis pa) rtsom dang brtsams chos kyi dpe ris bkod sgrig 113

byed/༵'a/jugagibashad khrid gnad chings gzur gnas 'jug ngogs/byed ༵/gsum pa) rtsom 'jug gi bsam pa'i 'char tshul mthun sgrig gsum ba/ bsam bkod kyi blang bya/dgo~X ṭā/nga po) gsog 'jog 'then sgrig byas te gsal snang 'dren (gnyis pa) bsam pa'i 'gros rgya cher spos nas phyogs mang po nas khungs sne btsal dgos/(gsum pa) zab mtshar brtson len byas te/ gsar pa bsgrun par mkhas dgos/bzhi ba/ bsam bkod kyi nus pa rje mthor gtong ba'i thabs lam/(dang po)'tsho ba'i myong brgyud je phyug tu gtong ba dang shes yon sna tshogs gsog 'jog bya dgos/dgo~X/gnyis pa)dbye zhib rigs bsgre ba'i nus pa sbyong brdar bya (gsum pa)rnam rtog dang 'brel rtog gi nus pa je mthor gardo/ dgos/

sa bcad gsum pa/ bsam bkod kyi dus rim/(bzhi ba) gcig min 'tshol ba dang gsar sgrun 'du shes je drag tu gtong dgos/don tshan gnyis pa/ dgongs don gtso bo'i 'dor len dang mtshon tshul/dang po/ dgongs don gartso bo'i go don dang byed las/(dang po) go don/dgongs don gtso bo ni rtsom pa pos rtsom hril po nas bstan pa'i bsam blo gtso bo yin/(gnyis pa)byed las/1 dgongs don gtso bo ni rtsom gyi dmag spyi yin pa/2 dgongs don gtso bo ni rtsom gyi bla srog yin pa/gnyis pa/ dgongs don gartso bo'i byung tshul dang 'dor len/(dang po) dgongs gtso byung ba'i go rim/spyi'i bab steng nas bltas na/ rtsom kyi dgongs don gtso bo ni tshogs 'tsho ba dang lag len dang rtsom mkhan gyi rgyu char dbye zhib dang zhib 'jug dang tshor shes byas pa las 'ongs pa red/ 1༵na

rtsom 'jug gi bshad khrid gnad chings gzur gnas 'jug ngogs/na'ang / rtsom 'jug yul can dang phyi yul gyi gnas tshul rnyog 'dzing che stabs/ dgongs gtso byung tshul yang mi gcig ste/ spyi khog steng nas bshad na rigs gsum yod de/1 yun ring gsog 'jog byas te rim gyis byung ba/2 yun thung 'tshol sdud byas te gang byung du thon pa/3 skabs 'gar reg skyod las byung ba/byed shākyāṭī/sa pa) dgongs gtso 'dor len byed pa'i gnad ka dang 1 dgongs gtso 'dor len byed pa'i gnad kadagongs gtso 'dor len byed pa'i gnad ka mi gcig pa mang trīsdo/ yang dag pa dang khyad mtshar dang gsar pa ha cang gal che ba 2 dgongs gtso 'dor len byed thabs/'dzirno /sgokābye/ zhib dang bsdur ba byas te rang bzhin gyi khyad chos (2)gsar pa sngog 'don dang zab rim gyi don btsal dgos/bco~X sdosgokāngo/sa gzugs phra mo la chags zhen dang gnas lugs 116

sa bca sna gsum pa/ bsam bkod kyi dus rim/gsum pa/ dgongs gtso mtshon tshul dang blang bya/(dang ngo )dgongs don gtso bo mtshon stangs dang mtshon thabs/dgongs don gtso bo'i mtshon stangs dang mtshon thabs la rnam grangs mang po mchis kyang spyi khog gi steng nas rigs gsum la phye chog1 thad kar mngon par ston pa/ (1)rtsom ming las ston pa/(2)rtsom sgo phye ste ston pa/ (3)rtsom nang du gsal por ston pa/ (4)mjug sdud las don ston pa/2 sbas te shugs las ston pa/ (1)don dag la bsdus te ston pa/ (2)yul ljongs la bsdus pa'am sbas te ston pa/ (3)dngos rdzas la bsdus te ston pa/ (4)mi sna'i snang brtan bzo bzhengs nang ñtsā /༵/ nas ston pa/ (5)phra rim dang bkod 'bri nang du sim nas 3 mngon sbas zung 'brel/(gnyis pa) dgongs don gtso bo'i blang bya/par /sa~X dī da/ ga pa/ 2 zab cing gnad la 'khel ba/ 3 mngon 117

rtsom 'jug gi bshad khrid gnad chings gzur gnas 'jug ngogs/don tshan gsum pa/ sgrig tshul gyi nang don dang byed thabs/dang po/ sgrig tshul gyi go don dang nang don/sgrig tshul ni rtsom gyi sgrig bkod dang chags stangs la zer ro/spyi'i bab steng nas bshad na sgrig tshul gyi nang don la gtso cher rim pa dang gtso phal/ rgyas bsdus dang 'brel mtshams/ dum ṭā/tā/ da/nga 'dren mthud/ mgo rtsom tshul dang mjug bsdu tshul bcas rdodad+ngha ṭ+wāṃ shā/rim pa dang dum bcad/rim pa ni nang don spel ba'i rim pa zer zhing / rtsom gyi rim pa sdosna ༵ / rno/ 'jog gi don cha tshang ba yod de/ rim pa ji ltar spel (1)dkyus phyogs 'phel rim ltar rim pa bkod sgrig byed pa/(2)'phred phyogs 'phel rim ltar rim pa bkod sgrig byed pa/(3)'phred dkyus bsnol ba'i byed stangs ltar rim pa sgrig pa bcas so/ /1182 dum bcad/

sa bcad gsum pa/ bsam bkod kyi dus rim/dum bcad zer ba ni rtsom nang du ltos bcas kyis nang don thad rang skya pher ba'i sde tshan yin la/ rim pa'i phyi tshul gyi rnam pa phyir mngon pa red/ rtsom gyi bsam blo'i nang don mtshon skabs dkyog mtshams dang shugs snon dang ngal gso sogs rkyen gyis yi ge'i steng gi sdod pa cung che ba red/ dum bcad ji ltar bgo dgos zhe na/ (1)sna rkyang rang bzhin dang 'thus tshang rang bzhin la do snang bya dgos/ (2)dum bcad dang rim pa/ dum bcad dang dum bcad bar gyi nang gi 'brel ba thag gcod yag po bya dgos/ (3)dum bcad la ring thung 'tshams pa bya dgos/rdog/py-i ༵ṭ+wāṃg/tso phal dang rgyas bsdus/gtso phal zer ba ni rtsom 'jug rgyu cha dang dgongs don gtso bo'i bsam blo'i 'brel ba steng nas bshad pa ste/ /dgongs gtso la 'brel ba thad kar yod pa dang dam pa ni gtso bo red/ 'brel ba cung ring ba dang mi dam pa ni phal ba red/2 rgyas bsdus/(gsum pa) 'brel mtshams dang 'dren mthud/1 'brel mtshams/rim pa dang dum bcad so so'i bar du mtshams sbyor ba dang brje spor byed tshul la 'brel mtshams zer zhing ming gzhan la bar 119

rgal ༵nga droṭ+wāṃn ro ma/thud/'dren mthud zer ba ni rtsom gyi nang don kha shas kyi snga phyi ram 'degs dang gcig grogs gcig gis byed pa dang gcig ya gcig gis 'degs pa red /rdobaṭī lha ༵zlo/ ༵ shāṭ+wāṃ/sa tshul dang mjug bsdu tshul/rtsom mgo 'dzugs tshul sna tshogs mchis kyang phyogs bsdus byas na rigs gnyidī yod de/ brjod bya la thad kar 'jug pa dang bskor nas dījukā zlog /bsdu rmya/rtsom mjug bsdu tshul mang yang spyi khog nas bshad na rigs gsum yod de/ shugs kyis rta rgyug pa 'gog pa dang / mjug mar tāspya~Xkā /do/na gtso bo bstan pa dang zas bro lhag ma dang ldan pa gnyis pa/ sgrig tshul gyi rtsa don dang blang bya/(dang po) sgrig tshul gyi bkod sgrig nges par du dgongs gtso sdoshāshā/ pa'i dgos mkho dang rtsom lus mi 'dra ba'i khyad chos la mthun 120(gnyis pa) sgrig tshul bkod sgrig ni nges par du phyi yul bya

sa bcad gsum pa/ bsam bkod kyi dus rim/dngos kyi nang gi 'brel ba dang 'phel ba'i chos nyid la mthun dgos/(gsum pa) sgrig tshul rang byung dang mthun 'grig bya dgos/(bzhi pa) sgrig tshul tshags dam zhing 'thus tshang bya dgos/(lnga pa) sgrig tshul gsar pa dang mtshar pa bya dgos/gsum pa/ sgrig tshul gyi byed babs/(dang po) bsam pa'i 'gros dag sgrig gsal po byas nas sgrig tshul gyi khungs sne gtan 'khel bya dgos/(gnyis pa) gtan tshigs khong du chud par byas te thag ring nye 'brel dgos pa/bsgrirno /sna~X/ pa) thabs 'phrul gang 'tsham bkol nas legs par 121

rtsom 'jug gi bshad khrid gnad chings gzur gnas 'jug ngogs/sa bcad bzhi ba/ mtshon brjod kyi dus rim/don tshan dang po/ gnad bsdus 'god pa dang rtsom phreng spel ba/gnad bsdus 'god pa dang rtsom phreng spel ba ni mtshon brjod dus rim gyi lhu tshigs dang po dang / snang med byed mi rung ba'i lhu tshigs gal chen zhig kyang yin/dang po/ gnad bskus 'god pa/(dang po) gnad bsdus 'god pa'i byed las/1 gnad bsdus 'god pa ni bsam blo dag sgrig byed pa'i go rim zhig yin/spyir bshad na rtsom ming 'dems pa dang rgyu cha 'tshol sdud dang gdam gses byas pa brgyud de rtsom mkhan gyis rtsom gyi rags dbyibs la blo bkod tsam yod kyang / bsam blo steng nas rim pa mi 'khrug pa dang cha tshang ba dang gsal po med de/ gnad bsdus bkod pa ༵/da de gnad don la bsam gzhig byed pa cha tshang ba dang

sa bcad bzhi ba/ mtshon brjod kyi dus rim/tshags dam pa dang rim pa dang ldan par 'gyur ro/ /2 gnad bsdus 'god pa ni rtsom gyi rus sgrom la skyon sel thengs zhig byas pa'i go rim yin/3 gnad bsdus legs pa' bkod na rtsom phreng spel ba'i dus su brtsi srung bya yul yod de/ gang zhig phye ba dang gang zhig 'dzum pa/gang zhig bsdus pa dang / gang zhig rgyas pa/ gang zhig bsrings pa dang gang zhig bsdus pa byed dgos pa de dag la gdeng tshod chen po yod pa ma zad/ 'dang re brgyab ste cung re 'bri ba dang gang la 'dang brgyab ste slebs na de 'bri ba'i rmongs thom 'char gzhi med pa'i skyon 'gog bub po/ /(gnyis pa) gnad bsdus 'god pa'i rtsa don/1 gnad 'dril zhing gsal ba/2 dngos bkol/(gsum pa) gnad bsdus kyi nang don/spyir na gnad bsdus kyi nang don du rtsom ming dang rtsom gyi dgongs don gtso bo/ rgyu cha'i sdeb sbyor dang rim pa sogs 'du'o/ /(bzhi ba) gnad bsdus kyi rigs/rgyas bsdus kyi tshad mi 'dra ba gzhir bzung ste/ gnad bsdus ni r+shag/sa pa'i gnad bsdus dang phra zhib gnad bsdus gnyis su phye chog 123

rtsom 'jug gi bshad khrid gnad chings gzur gnas 'jug ngogs/yig thog yig gzugs su bkod yod med kyis sgo nas gnad bsdus ni khog gdan dang yig thog gnad bsdus gnyis su phye yod/gnyis pa/ rtsom zeng spel ba/rtsom phreng spel ba ni skad cha legs par bkod nas rtsom yongs ṭ+wāṃ //nga don mngon par mtshon te/ rtsom gdan 'grub par byed pa la (dang po) rtsom phreng spel thabs/1 gnad bsdus kyi rim pa ltar rtsom phreng spel ba/2 byang tshad ltar rtsom phreng spel ba/(gnyis pa) rtsom phreng spel ba'i blang bya/gtong1 ba/dgongs gtso dam par bzung nas yal ga rang yan du mi 2 dutrī tshod gcig bsdus byas te dbugs thengs gcig gis 'grub 3paṭ+wāṃ bye t+na trī/ 'ong na gnas skabs btsan 'bri mi byed pa/4yig gzugs gsal ba dang stong cha 'jog pa/124

sa bcad bzhi ba/ mchod brjod kyi dus rim/don tshan gnyis pa/ skad cha'i bkol tshul/dang po/ rtsom gyi skad cha'i go don/rtsom gyi skad cha ni rtsom gyi tshig sbyor ji snyed la bya zhing / tshig gzhan bshad na/ rtsom gyi rjod byed kyi ngag mtha' dag go brjod pa sdo/nga/ skad cha dang tshig sbyor rnams don gcig ming gi rnam grangs yin gnyis pa/ tshig sbyor spel ba'i blang bya/(dang po) gnad la 'khel ba/(gnyis pa) tshig 'dril zhing gtsang ba/(gsum pa) gson nyams ldan pa/lam/gsum pa/ skad cha'i blo smyong rje mthor gtong ba'i thabs (dang po) mang tshogs kyi skad cha la slob sbyong bya dgos/(gnyis pa) gna' deng phyi nang gi tshab mtshon rang bzhin gyi bstan bcos grags can gyi skad cha la slob gnyer bya dgos/go (gsum pa) ming gi tshogs pa phun sum tshogs par gtong da sa/ 125

rtsom 'jug gi bshad khrid gnad chings gzur gnas 'jug ngogs/(bzhi ba) 'bri ba dang skyon sel mang po byas te skad cha sbyong brdar bya dgos/don tshan gsum pa/ mtshon stangs kyi bkol tshul/mtshon stangs zer ba ni rtsom nang du bye brag tu bkol ba'i 'bri stangs la bstan pa yin zhing / don brjod pa dang mi 'bri ba dang yul smongs ris su phab pa dang yid 'gyur mtshon pa sogs kyi dgos mkho la bstun ched mtshon stangs mi 'dra ba bkol dgos pa red/dang po/ spros brjod/spros brjod ni mi sna'i myong brgyud dang don rkyen byung 'phel gyi go rim brjod pa'i mtshon stangs shig yin la/ de ni ches sla ba'i mtshon stangs zhig go /spros brjod 'thus tshang zhig la mi sna dang don dag dus tshod dang sa gnas dang 'byung rkyen dang mtha' 'bras te phyogs drug gi py-it+yā/ don ldan dgos zhing / de la spros brjod kyi rgyu rkyen drug ces (dang po)spros brjod kyi rigs dang byed stangs/spros brjod ni rgyas bsdus dang rags zhib kyi steng nas rags brjod dang zhib brjod de rigs gnyis su phye chog ste/ rags brjod 126

sa bcad bzhi ba/ mtshon brjod kyi dus rim/ni ches rags bsdus kyi skad cha bkol te mi sna dang don dag mdor bsdus kyis mtshams sbyor byas pa red/ zhib brjod ni don dag dang mi sna phra zhib dang bye brag gis ngo sprod dang spros bshad byas pa zer zhing / de la bye brag gi spros brjod kyang bya'o/ /spros brjod kyi byed stangs gtso che ba ni rim 'jug dang ldog 'jug dang gseb 'jug dang snon 'jug dang mnyam 'jug bcas rigs lnga yod do/ /rim 'jug ni phyi yul bya dngos kyi byung 'phel gyi snga phyi'i rim pa ltar spros brjod byas pa red/ldog 'jug ni don dag gi mtha' mjug dang mtho rlabs kyi phyogs cha sngon du brjod de yang skyar byung ba dang 'phel ba bris nas rim pa ltar mtha' mjug la thug pa'o/ /gseb 'jug ni don dag gal chen spros brjod byed pa'i go zlotrī //nga du de dang 'brel ba'i don dag gseb nas spros brjod byas snon 'jug ni rtsom phreng gong ma spros brjod byed pa'i nang du bsam pa'i bzhin du sbas pa'i lhu tshigs 'ga' la kha snon gyis mtshams sbyor byas pa'o/ /mnyam 'jug ni sa gnas mi gcig pa'i nang du dus mnyam du byung pa'i don dag gnyis sam de'i yan chad spros brjod byas pa1 rti/

rtsom 'jug gi bshad khrid gnad chings gzur gnas 'jug ngogs/de'i ming gzhan la dbye brjod kyang zer ro/ /(gnyis pa) spros brjod kyi gang zag gi 'bod ming /spros brjod kyi gang zag gi 'bod ming ni rtsom mkhan gyis spros brjod byed dus bzung ba'i lta rtog dang rkang tshugs byed sa ste/gnad ka gang zhig nas mgo brtsams te bshad stangs gang 'dra bkol te gnad don spros brjod byas pa'o/ /rtsom mkhan gyis don dag la dngos su zhugs pa'i zur tshad steng nas nga dang nga tsho zhes thob thang dang bshad stangs bzung ste go myong mthong gsum spros brjod byas pa der gang zag gi 'bod ming dang po zer/ gang zag gi 'bod ming dang po ni tho 'god rtsom nang trī /sna/ pa/ po yin zhing / rig rtsom brtsams chos nang du rtsom mkhan gang zag gi 'bod ming gsum pa ni rtsom pa pos phyi'i mi'i zur tshad steng nas spros brjod mkhan kyi thob stangs dang bshad stangs bzung ste/ mi'i sna'i 'gul skyod dang don dag gi brgyud rim gyi gnas tshul spros brjod byas pa yin no/ /(gsum pa) spros brjod kyi blang bya/ltar/spros brjod byed dus nges par du bya dgos pa gsham gsal 1 spros brjod kyi rgyu rkyen gtso bo ngo sprod gsal por bya dgos/128

sa bcad bzhi ba/ mtshon brjod kyi dus rim/2 spros brjod kyi skud sne gsal por dgos pa/3 spros brjod rgyas bsdus 'tsham par bya dgos pa/dgosashā /spros brjod la rlabs phreng dang 'gyur bag phun sum chogs gnyis pa/ bkod 'bri/bkod 'bri ni snyan 'jebs yid dbang 'phrog pa'i tshig sbyor gyi steng nas mi sna dang yul ljongs kyi bkod pa 'bri ba de la zer zhing /tshig gzhan bshad na/ snang brnyan dang gson nyams ldan pa'i skad cha bkol nas 'bri yul gyi byad bzhin dang rnam 'gyur sogs ris su phab pa'i mtshon stangs shig la bya'o/ /(dang po) bkod 'bri'i rigs dbye/bkod 'bri bya yul gyi steng nas mi sna bkod 'bri dang yul ljongs datrī ༵ rilha bkod 'bri bcas 'bri bcas phra rim bkod 'bri bcas 1la rte bye ṭā kosdo/ 'brimi sna bkod 'bri ni mi sna'i phyogs so so'i gnas tshul bkod 'bri byas pa yin zhing / der gzugs ris bkod 'bri dang skad cha bkod 'bri/ bya byed bkod 'bri dang yid byed bkod 'bri ste rigs bzhi la phye rung ngo / /gzugs ris bkod 'bri ni mi sna'i bzhin rnam gyi khyad cho~X9

rtsom 'jug gi bshad khrid gnad chings gzur gnas 'jug ngogs/bkod 'bri byas pa ste/ de yang mi sna'i bzhin ras dang gyon gos dang skyes gzugs dang rnam 'gyur dang 'jags rnam dang 'gul rnam sogs bkod 'bri byed pa'o/ /skad cha bkod 'bri ni mi sna'i skad cha(gleng mol dang kher bshad)dang rang gshis can gyi skad cha bkol nas mi sna'i 'byung khams ris su phab pa'o/ /yid byed bkod 'bri ni mi sna'i yid kyi 'gul skyod bkod 'bri byas pa brgyud de mi sna'i nang sems kyi 'jig rten dang mi sna'i bsam pa'i ngang tshul mtshon pa red/bya byed bkod 'bri ni mi sna'i bya spyod brgyud de mi sna'i rang gshis mtshon pa la zer/2 yul ljongs bkod 'bri/yul smongs bkod 'bri ni rang byung yul ljongs dang spyi tshogs khor yug dang 'tshogs stangs bkod 'bri byas pa red/3 phra rim bkod 'bri/bya dngos nang gi shin tu phra ba'i cha dang mi sna'i rnam 'gyur 'gul stangs phra mo bkod 'bri byas pa la phra rim bkod 'bri zer ro//(gnyis pa) bkod 'bri byed thabs/bkod 'bri'i nyams 'gyur gyi steng nas phra 'god dang skya 'god gaṭ+wāṃsdu su phye chog la/ gnad ka'i steng nas thad kar bkod 'bri dang

sa bcad bzhi ba/ mtshon brjod kyi dus rim/brgyud pa'i bkod 'bri la phye rung /1 phra 'god ni phra zhib kyi 'bri tshul bkod nas bkod 'bri bya yul gyi phyogs 'ga' zhig la phra brko byed pa'i bkod 'bri la zer/2 skya 'god ni bab chags pa dang snying bsdus kyi 'bri tshul bkol nas bkod 'bri bya yul gyi khyad chos bkod 'bri byas pa red/3 thad kar bkod 'bri la drang phyogs kyi bkod 'bri yang zer zhing / de ni bkod 'bri bya yul la thad kar drang phyogs kyi ris 'be+ebs byas te snang bsnyan gyi khyad chos brko 'bri byas pa'o/ /4brgyud pa'i bkod 'bri/brgyud pa'i bkod 'bri la gzhogs ngos bkod 'bri yang zer la/de ni bkod 'bri bya yul la thad kar ris 'be+ebs mi byed par zur rgyan gyi thabs bkol nas zur phyogs nas mi gzhan gyis mtshams sbyor dang ldog rgyan byed pa'i thabs spyad de bkod 'bri byas pa red/(gsum pa) bkod 'bri'i blang bya/1 dmigs yul gsal ba/2 khyad chos 'bur du thon pa/3 bye brag dang gson nyams ldan pa/gsum pa/ yid 'gyur mtshon pa/(dang po) yid 'gyur mtshon pa'i go don/rtsom pa pos bsam pa'i 'gyur bag mtshon pa la zer ro/ /131

rtsom 'jug gi bshad khrid gnad chings gzur gnas 'jug ngogs/(gnyis pa) yid 'gyur mtshon thabs/yid 'gyur mtshon pa la byed thabs rigs gnyis yod de thad kar yid 'gyur mtshon pa dang brgyud de yid 'gyur mtshon pa'o/ /thad kar yid 'gyur mtshon pa ni sems khong gi bsam pa'i 'gyur bag thad kar gsang spas med par mtshon pa la zer/ brgyud de yid 'gyur mtshon pa ni rtsom pa pos spros brjod dang bkod 'bri dang bgro gleng gi byed stangs la brten nas yid 'gyur mtshon pa red/(gsum pa)yid 'gyur mtshon pa'i blang bya/1 bden pa dang rang byung yin pa/2 dgongs gtso mtshon par brtsi 'jog dgos pa/3 bde thang dang yag po yin pa/bzhi pa/ bgro gleng /bgro gleng ni rtsom pa pos phyi yul bya dngos la dbye zhib dang k+tasprasdu trī//da byas te rang gi lta tshul dang rnam 'gyur ston pa'i mtshon (dang po)bgro gleng gi grub cha gtso bo/bgro gleng 'thus tshang zhig la nges par du bsgrub bya dang sgrub byed dang bsgrub tshul te grub cha gsum ldan dgos/ bsgrub bya dang sgrub byed dang bsgrub tshul ni gtan tshigs kyi gnad ka nas bshad na bsgrub tshul gyi sgrig tshul zer ba dang / skad cha'i gnad ka nas bshad 132

sa bcad bzhi ba/ mtshon brjod kyi dus rim/na/ bgro gleng gi grub cha gtso bo gsum bya'o/ /rdogaṭ+wāṃ~X drosgobagro gleng gi rigs/sgrub ngag ni thad kar sgrub byed 'thus tshang bkol te drang phyogs nas bsgrub bya bsgrubs pa dang bden dpang byed pa la zer/ /2 sun 'byin/sun 'byin ni pha rol po'i nor 'khrul dang log spyod kyi bsgrub bya de la mtshang 'byin dang dgag pa brgyab ste rang lugs yang dag par 'jog pa la bya zhing / don dag dang gnad don nges can zhig la 'dod tshul mi mthun pa bton nas dgag pa brgyab pa'o/ /(gsum pa) bgro gleng byed stangs/1 rnam 'byed(ṭīr+sātshortsocho)kyi bsgrub tshul/sngon 'gro cha rkyen chen po zhig nas mgo brtsams te spyir btang gi gnas lugs brgyud de bye brag gi gnas lugs bsgrubs pa dang de nas sdom tshig 'jog pa red/2 sdud sgrig( )zapo)gi bsgrub tshul/de ni rnam 'byed kyi bsgrig tshul las ldog pa ste/ bye brag tshab mtshon gyi bya dngos la dbye zhib byas pa brgyud de yongs khyab kyi don yod pa'i spyir btang gi rtsa ba'i gnas lugs rigs 'ded dang sdom tshig 'jog pa'i bsgrub tshul red/ 133

rtsom 'jug gi bshad khrid gnad chings gzur gnas 'jug ngogs/3 rigs bsdur gyi bsgrub tshul/de ni bya dngos sam gnas lugs rigs gcig pa phan tshun bsdur nas rigs 'ded byed pa'i bsgrub tshul la zer ba red/(bzhi ba)bgro gleng gi blang bya/1 bsgrub bya gsal pa/2 sgrub byed ni bden pa dang tshab mtshon/ gsar pa dang shugs ldan pa/3 bsgrub tshul ni bsgrub bya dang sgrub byed gcig gyur yin pa/lnga pa/ gsal bshad/(dang po) gsal bshad go don/gsal bshad zer ba ni brjod bya'i dngos po la mtshams sbyor dang 'grel bshad byas pa'o/ /(gnyis pa) gsal bshad kyi byed thabs/1 rags bshad/rags bshad la rags bsdus su bshad pa zer zhing / bya dngos kyi ngo bo dang khyad chos rnams kha gsal zhing gnad 'dril ba'i sgo shās gsal bshadare byas te nyan mkhan la bya dngos kyi rags dbyibs sa trī 'a/py-in pa nyiwad 'a/jog pa/134de ni bya dngos kyi ngo bo la mtshan nyid bzhag ste gsal bshad

sa bcad bzhi ba/ mtshon brjod kyi dus rim/byas ༵ la' shādī kā r+shasdo//'grel bshad ni bya dngos kyi khyad chos la sgo kun nas 'grel ba dang ༵rno ༵shār+sha sdo/sa pa red/rnam bshad la rnam 'byed gsal bshad zer zhing / de ni bya dngos ṭ+wāṃg 'dzing can gsal bshad byed dus rigs phyes te ngo sprod byas kā /ba/sdur bshad/ba resdo/ ni bya dngos gnyis bsdur nas gsal bshad byas pa la zer 6 dpe mtshon gsal bshad/dpe 'jog gsal bshad ni dper bkod pa dang dpyad gzhi lung drangs te gsal bshad byas pa red/7 re'u mig gi gsal bshad/de ni re'u mig dang dpe ris bkol nas bya dngos kyi khyad chos sogs gsal bshad byas pa red/(gsum pa) gsal bshad kyi blang bya/1 yang dag pa'i sgo nas bya dngos kyi khyad rtags gsal bshad bya dgos la/ der tshan rig rang bzhin yang yod/ 135

rtsom 'jug gi bshad khrid gnad chings gzur gnas 'jug ngogs/dgos2/ bya dngos kyi rang bzhin gsal bshad byed par mkhas 3 phyi yul la don mthun gyi sgo nas gsal bshad bya dgos/rngugasal bshad kyi skad cha tshags dam pa dang go sla ba/ gnad 'dril zhing gsal po bcas su bya dgos/don tshan bzhi ba/ rtsom gyi skyon sel dang yig ngos bkod sgrigadang po/ rtsom gyi skyon sel/rtsom gyi skyon sel la sgra yangs dog gnyis yod de/ sgra yangs 'jug gi skyon sel nang du rtsom phreng ma spel gong gi skyon sel dang rtsom phreng spel ba'i go rim nang gi skyon sel/ rtsom 'grub par byas pa'i rjes kyi skyon sel bcas 'dus shing / de gsum gyi skyon sel ni shin tu gal che ba red/ sgra dog 'jug gi rtsom gyi skyon sel ni rtsom gdan btings ba'i rjes kyi skyon sel te/ 'dir brjod pa ni sgra dog 'jug gi rtsom gyi skyon sel yin/(dang po)skyon sel gyi khongs mtshams/rtsom ni nang don dang rnam pa gnyis kyi phyogs su 'dus zhing /skyon sel gyi khongs mtshams spyang phyogs de gnyis las mi 'da' ste/136
